g_ir.name: builder_percentile_budget_gap_002
g_ir.intuition: pairwise: replace fixed global top-k by an adaptive per-instance percentile cap on objective-gap strength, then apply a global budget topk within remaining candidates; keeps pair counts proportional to instance difficulty while still bounding total work
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    budget = int(hp.get('pair_budget', 1024))
    q = float(hp.get('gap_quantile', 0.9))  # keep pairs with gap >= per-instance quantile

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Strict preference direction (lower objective is better): i beats j if oi < oj.
    win_mask = oi < oj  # [B, N, N]

    # Positive gap for valid directed wins.
    gap = oj - oi  # [B, N, N]

    neg_inf = gap.new_full(gap.shape, float('-inf'))
    score = gap.where(win_mask, neg_inf)

    # Per-instance adaptive threshold: compute quantile over finite candidate gaps.
    flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
    finite = flat.isfinite()

    # Replace -inf with 0 for quantile computation; also track if any candidates exist.
    flat_safe = flat.where(finite, flat.new_zeros(()))
    any_finite = finite.any(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # [B,1]

    # Clamp q to [0,1]. If no candidates, set threshold to +inf so mask becomes empty.
    if q < 0.0:
        q_eff = 0.0
    elif q > 1.0:
        q_eff = 1.0
    else:
        q_eff = q

    thr = flat_safe.quantile(q_eff, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    pos_inf = flat.new_full((B, 1), float('inf'))
    thr = thr.where(any_finite, pos_inf)

    # Keep only pairs above threshold, then apply global budget top-k per instance.
    keep = flat >= thr
    score2 = flat.where(keep, neg_inf.reshape(B, N * N))

    b_eff = budget
    if b_eff <= 0:
        b_eff = 1
    max_pairs = int(N * N)
    if b_eff > max_pairs:
        b_eff = max_pairs

    top_score, top_flat = score2.topk(b_eff, dim=1, largest=True)
    valid = top_score.isfinite()  # [B, b_eff]

    i_idx = (top_flat // N).to(dtype=top_flat.dtype)
    j_idx = (top_flat - i_idx * N).to(dtype=top_flat.dtype)

    nz = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=False)
    b_idx = nz[:, 0]
    kk = nz[:, 1]

    winner_i = i_idx[b_idx, kk]
    loser_j = j_idx[b_idx, kk]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_i, loser_j), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'percentile_then_global_budget', 'pair_budget': b_eff, 'gap_quantile': q_eff})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):

    band_k = int(hp.get('band_k', 2))  # number of worse neighbors per item in rank order
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))  # 0 => uncapped

    # Weighting: emphasize informative-but-not-extreme gaps via softcap normalization
    w_temp = float(hp.get('w_temp', 1.0))
    w_cap = float(hp.get('w_cap', 10.0))
    w_eps = float(hp.get('w_eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if band_k < 1:
        band_k = 1
    if N <= 1:
        b_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        i_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        j_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        weight = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_adjacent_normw', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band_k': int(band_k), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total)})

    # Rank by objective ascending (lower is better)
    order = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, stable=True)  # (B,N)

    # Build rank-band pairs: for each position p, compare to positions p+d (d=1..K)
    K = band_k
    if K > (N - 1):
        K = N - 1

    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[None, :].expand(B, N)  # (B,N)
    d = torch.arange(1, K + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[None, None, :].expand(B, N, K)  # (B,N,K)
    pos_w = pos[:, :, None].expand(B, N, K)  # (B,N,K)
    pos_l = pos_w + d  # (B,N,K)

    valid = pos_l < N

    w_idx = order.gather(1, pos_w.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, K)  # (B,N,K)
    l_idx = order.gather(1, pos_l.clamp(max=N - 1).reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, N, K)  # (B,N,K)

    # Mask invalid tail positions
    w_idx = torch.where(valid, w_idx, w_idx.new_zeros(()))
    l_idx = torch.where(valid, l_idx, l_idx.new_zeros(()))

    # Flatten pairs
    b_mat = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None, None].expand(B, N, K)
    b_flat = b_mat.reshape(-1)
    w_flat = w_idx.reshape(-1)
    l_flat = l_idx.reshape(-1)
    v_flat = valid.reshape(-1)

    # Enforce strict improvement (should hold by ranking) + tie-zone filter
    gap = objective[b_flat, l_flat] - objective[b_flat, w_flat]
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        v_flat = v_flat & (gap > tie_eps)
    else:
        v_flat = v_flat & (gap > 0)

    b_idx = b_flat[v_flat]
    i_idx = w_flat[v_flat]
    j_idx = l_flat[v_flat]
    gap_sel = gap[v_flat]

    # Optional global cap: keep most informative (mid-sized) gaps by soft-capped weight score
    # weight_raw ~ tanh(gap/(temp)) then clamped
    denom_t = w_temp if w_temp > 0.0 else 1.0
    w_raw = torch.tanh(gap_sel / denom_t)
    w_raw = torch.clamp(w_raw, 0.0, float(w_cap))

    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        vals, sel = torch.topk(w_raw, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
        ok = vals.isfinite()
        sel = sel[ok]
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        i_idx = i_idx[sel]
        j_idx = j_idx[sel]
        w_raw = w_raw[sel]

    # Normalize weights to keep scale stable (and satisfy nonneg)
    if w_raw.numel() > 0:
        weight = w_raw / (w_raw.sum() + w_eps)
    else:
        weight = w_raw

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_adjacent_normw', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band_k': int(band_k), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'w_temp': float(w_temp), 'w_cap': float(w_cap)})

g_ir.intuition: Build a compact, high-signal set of pairwise preferences by anchoring each instance on its best (lowest objective) candidate, then selecting only the hardest losers with the largest objective gaps; this avoids quadratic all-pairs while keeping strong directional supervision (best beats clearly-worse).

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    # Per-instance cap (top-k losers for the best anchor)
    k_default = int(hp.get('pairs_per_instance', 2))
    k = int((extra.get('pairs_per_instance', k_default) if extra is not None else k_default))
    k = max(1, k)

    # Optional gap filtering to avoid near-ties
    thr_default = float(hp.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    thr = float((extra.get('gap_threshold', thr_default) if extra is not None else thr_default))

    B, N = objective.shape

    best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
    best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)

    # gap[b,i] > 0 means i is worse than best for that instance
    gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

    # Exclude the anchor itself and any losers not meeting the gap threshold
    valid = (gap > thr)
    valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

    # Ensure invalid entries never get selected by topk
    neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
    scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

    k_eff = min(k, N - 1)
    top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    loser_idx = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
    picked = top.values > neg_inf / 2  # robust validity check

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
    winner_idx = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

    b = b_idx[picked]
    w = winner_idx[picked]
    l = loser_idx[picked]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b, w, l), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_topk_gap', 'pairs_per_instance': k, 'gap_threshold': thr})

g_ir.intuition: All-pairs preference builder with tie-zone filtering and symmetric dedup, plus an explicit global top-k cap on hardest (largest objective gap) pairs and stable gap normalization/clamping to control pair count and numerical scale while preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better).
    better = oi < oj

    # Constraint 1: tie-zone filter.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Constraint 2: de-duplicate symmetric pairs by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Compute objective gap for scoring/capping; normalize and clamp for stability.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
    mean = gap.mean()
    var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
    std = (var + eps).sqrt()
    gap_n = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
    gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Constraint 3: global top-k cap (keep hardest/highest-gap pairs) to control pair volume.
    if max_pairs_total is not None and max_pairs_total > 0:
        k_eff = max_pairs_total
        if gap_n.numel() > k_eff:
            _, sel = gap_n.topk(k_eff, largest=True, sorted=False)
            b_idx = b_idx[sel]
            i_idx = i_idx[sel]
            j_idx = j_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_normcap', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total) if max_pairs_total is not None else 0, 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    k = hp.get('topk_per_anchor', 8)

    B, N = objective.shape
    # For each anchor i, candidates j with objective[i] < objective[j].
    win_mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]

    # Score candidate pairs by objective gap; invalid pairs get -inf so they won't be selected.
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]  # [B, i, j]
    neg_inf = gap.new_full(gap.shape, float('-inf'))
    score = gap.where(win_mask, neg_inf)

    # Select up to k losers per winner-anchor i.
    k_eff = int(k)
    if k_eff <= 0:
        k_eff = 1
    if k_eff > N:
        k_eff = N

    top_score, top_j = score.topk(k_eff, dim=2, largest=True)
    valid = top_score.isfinite()

    # Build pair indices (b, winner_i, loser_j) for valid selections.
    b_idx, winner_i, kk = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    loser_j = top_j[b_idx, winner_i, kk]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_i, loser_j), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'topk_per_anchor_gap', 'topk_per_anchor': k_eff})

g_ir.name: rankgap_topk_triu_noops_cumsumfix
g_ir.intuition: Construct within-instance pairwise preferences where strictly lower objective wins; remove near-ties via a positive objective-gap threshold; de-duplicate symmetric pairs by keeping only i<j; optionally cap pairs per instance by taking the top-k largest objective gaps; assign each pair a nonnegative weight from a detached softplus of the within-instance rank gap so larger separations contribute more without backpropagating into objectives.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    per_instance_k = int(hp.get('per_instance_k', 32))
    rank_temp = float(hp.get('rank_temp', 1.0))
    w_max = float(hp.get('w_max', 1.0e6))

    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # i is better than j when objective is strictly lower and outside the tie zone.
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    # Keep only i<j to de-duplicate symmetric pairs and remove self-pairs.
    idx = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    tri_keep = idx[None, :, None] < idx[None, None, :]
    better = better & tri_keep

    b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty_i64 = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        empty_w = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(empty_i64, empty_i64, empty_i64),
            weight=empty_w,
            meta={'tie_eps': tie_eps, 'per_instance_k': per_instance_k, 'rank_temp': rank_temp},
        )

    # Objective gap (positive when loser is worse).
    gap = objective[b_idx, l_idx] - objective[b_idx, w_idx]

    # ranks[b,a] = number of actions with strictly lower objective than action a.
    ranks = (objective[:, None, :] < objective[:, :, None]).to(torch.long).sum(dim=2)
    delta_rank = (ranks[b_idx, l_idx] - ranks[b_idx, w_idx]).to(objective.dtype)

    w = torch.nn.functional.softplus(rank_temp * delta_rank.detach())
    w = torch.clamp(w, 0.0, w_max)

    # Optional per-instance top-k cap by objective gap.
    if per_instance_k > 0:
        # Sort by instance id so we can compute a per-instance position without loops.
        order = torch.argsort(b_idx)
        b_s = b_idx[order]
        w_s = w_idx[order]
        l_s = l_idx[order]
        gap_s = gap[order]
        w_s_weight = w[order]

        ones = torch.ones_like(b_s, dtype=torch.long)
        counts = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=torch.long).scatter_add(0, b_s, ones)
        offsets = torch.cumsum(counts, dim=0) - counts
        local_pos = (torch.cumsum(ones, dim=0) - 1) - offsets[b_s]

        max_cnt_t = counts.max()
        max_cnt = int(max_cnt_t.item()) if max_cnt_t.numel() > 0 else 0
        if max_cnt > 0:
            flat = objective.new_full((B * max_cnt,), -1.0e30)
            flat_idx = (b_s * max_cnt + local_pos).to(torch.long)
            flat = flat.scatter(0, flat_idx, gap_s)
            gap_mat = flat.view(B, max_cnt)

            k_eff = per_instance_k if per_instance_k < max_cnt else max_cnt
            topk_vals, _ = torch.topk(gap_mat, k_eff, dim=1)
            thr = topk_vals[:, -1]
            keep = gap_s >= thr[b_s]

            b_idx = b_s[keep]
            w_idx = w_s[keep]
            l_idx = l_s[keep]
            w = w_s_weight[keep]

    b_idx = b_idx.to(torch.long).view(-1)
    w_idx = w_idx.to(torch.long).view(-1)
    l_idx = l_idx.to(torch.long).view(-1)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx),
        weight=w,
        meta={'tie_eps': tie_eps, 'per_instance_k': per_instance_k, 'rank_temp': rank_temp},
    )

g_ir.intuition: Anchor each instance on its best candidate, but explicitly handle constraints by filtering near-ties (tie-zone) and capping per-instance pair count to stabilize training and avoid degenerate pairs.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    # Constraint knobs
    tie_eps = hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0)
    max_pairs_per_instance = hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 2048)
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(max_pairs_per_instance)
    if max_pairs_per_instance < 1:
        max_pairs_per_instance = 1

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    best = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)
    all_idx = torch.arange(N, device=device)[None, :].expand(B, N)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, N)
    winner_idx = best.expand(B, N)
    loser_idx = all_idx

    # Base: no self-pairs
    base_mask = winner_idx != loser_idx

    # Explicit constraint: filter near-ties between best and candidate (tie-zone)
    best_obj = objective.gather(1, best).expand(B, N)
    gap = objective - best_obj
    tie_mask = gap > tie_eps

    mask = base_mask & tie_mask

    # Per-instance cap: keep top-k largest gaps (hardest losers) among valid pairs
    gap_pos = torch.clamp(gap, min=0.0)
    scores = gap_pos.masked_fill(~mask, float('-inf'))
    k = max_pairs_per_instance
    if k > N - 1:
        k = N - 1
    if k < 1:
        k = 1
    _, topk_idx = scores.topk(k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    cap_mask = torch.zeros((B, N), dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    cap_mask.scatter_(1, topk_idx, True)
    mask = mask & cap_mask

    b = b_idx[mask]
    w = winner_idx[mask]
    l = loser_idx[mask]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b, w, l), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_best_tiecap', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance)})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total budget across the whole batch (0 => uncapped).
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))

    # Per-instance budget split between anchor-star and dense pairs.
    anchor_frac = float(hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.25))

    # Anchor controls
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Build dense all-pairs preferences: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and outside tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_d < j_d
    b_d = b_d[keep]
    i_d = i_d[keep]
    j_d = j_d[keep]

    # Dense gap for scoring.
    gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Anchor star: best beats selected losers.
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_a = top.values[picked]

    # Per-instance budgets (equal share of total across B).
    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and B > 0:
        per_inst = max_pairs_total // B
        if per_inst < 1:
            per_inst = 1

        # Split into anchor and dense allocations.
        anchor_budget = int(per_inst * anchor_frac)
        if anchor_budget < 0:
            anchor_budget = 0
        dense_budget = per_inst - anchor_budget
        if dense_budget < 0:
            dense_budget = 0

        # Within-instance top-k for anchor edges (already bounded by anchor_k).
        if anchor_budget > 0 and b_a.numel() > 0:
            # (B, Ka) score matrix
            Ka = 0
            # Recover Ka from indices shape if possible; otherwise infer from counts via max per b using scatter.
            # We'll build a padded matrix using scatter over (b, slot) from a stable slot assignment.
            # Create slot ids by ranking within each b via a second topk on padded scores.
            # First, build padded scores for exactly k_eff candidates per instance (before picked mask).
            # If picked mask filtered, we keep only picked and then do per-b topk using a padded matrix of size N-1.
            # For simplicity and vectorization: compute per-b threshold via topk on full scores again.
            best = objective.argmin(dim=1)
            best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])
            gap_full = objective - best_obj
            valid_full = gap_full > anchor_gap
            valid_full.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)
            neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
            scores_full = torch.where(valid_full, gap_full, neg_inf)  # (B,N)

            k_sel = anchor_budget
            if k_sel > (N - 1):
                k_sel = N - 1
            if k_sel > 0:
                top2 = torch.topk(scores_full, k=k_sel, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
                picked2 = top2.values > (neg_inf / 2)
                b3 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_sel)
                i3 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_sel)
                b_a = b3[picked2]
                i_a = i3[picked2]
                j_a = top2.indices[picked2]
                gap_a = top2.values[picked2]
            else:
                b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        else:
            b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

        # Within-instance top-k for dense edges using a padded (B, M) matrix.
        if dense_budget > 0 and b_d.numel() > 0:
            # Pack dense candidates into a B x M matrix (M = max count per instance), then topk per row.
            ones = torch.ones_like(b_d, dtype=torch.long)
            counts = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            counts.scatter_add_(0, b_d, ones)
            M = int(counts.max().item()) if counts.numel() > 0 else 0

            if M > 0:
                # Assign slot per candidate within its instance: slot = cumsum over occurrences - 1.
                # We do this without Python loops by using a stable sort on (b_d, -gap_d) to define ordering,
                # then compute per-b offsets via scatter.
                # Sort keys: first by b, then by descending gap.
                key = b_d.to(torch.long) * (gap_d.new_tensor(0.0) + 0.0)  # dummy to keep dtype separation
                # Use lexicographic-like ordering by mapping to a single key with large stride on b.
                # Since torch doesn't have argsort for pairs, approximate with two-stage stable sorts.
                # Stage 1: sort by -gap (stable)
                s1 = torch.argsort(-gap_d, stable=True)
                b_s = b_d[s1]
                i_s = i_d[s1]
                j_s = j_d[s1]
                g_s = gap_d[s1]
                # Stage 2: stable sort by b
                s2 = torch.argsort(b_s, stable=True)
                b_s = b_s[s2]
                i_s = i_s[s2]
                j_s = j_s[s2]
                g_s = g_s[s2]

                # slot ids: running count within each b.
                slot = torch.zeros_like(b_s, dtype=torch.long)
                # Compute slot via scatter_add on a per-b counter using inclusive prefix in sorted order.
                # We can get slot by: slot = arange(len) - first_index_of_b
                if b_s.numel() > 0:
                    change = torch.ones_like(b_s, dtype=torch.long)
                    # first occurrence indices per b in sorted b_s
                    first = torch.full((B,), b_s.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                    idx_ar = torch.arange(b_s.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                    first.scatter_reduce_(0, b_s, idx_ar, reduce='amin', include_self=True)
                    slot = idx_ar - first[b_s]

                # Build padded matrices
                neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
                score_mat = objective.new_full((B, M), neg_inf)
                i_mat = torch.zeros((B, M), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
                j_mat = torch.zeros((B, M), device=device, dtype=torch.long)

                in_range = slot < M
                b_ok = b_s[in_range]
                s_ok = slot[in_range]
                score_mat[b_ok, s_ok] = g_s[in_range]
                i_mat[b_ok, s_ok] = i_s[in_range]
                j_mat[b_ok, s_ok] = j_s[in_range]

                k_sel = dense_budget
                if k_sel > M:
                    k_sel = M
                if k_sel > 0:
                    topd = torch.topk(score_mat, k=k_sel, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
                    pickedd = topd.values > (neg_inf / 2)
                    b4 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_sel)
                    slot_sel = topd.indices

                    b_d2 = b4[pickedd]
                    s_d2 = slot_sel[pickedd]
                    i_d2 = i_mat[b_d2, s_d2]
                    j_d2 = j_mat[b_d2, s_d2]
                    g_d2 = topd.values[pickedd]

                    b_d = b_d2
                    i_d = i_d2
                    j_d = j_d2
                    gap_d = g_d2
                else:
                    b_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                    i_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                    j_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                    gap_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
            else:
                b_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                i_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                j_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
                gap_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        else:
            b_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            i_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            j_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            gap_d = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    # Combine dense + anchor
    b_idx = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
    i_idx = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
    j_idx = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_peranchor_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

    device = objective.device

    if anchor_frac > 1.0:
        anchor_frac = 1.0
    if dense_keep_q < 0.0:
        dense_keep_q = 0.0
    if dense_keep_q > 1.0:
        dense_keep_q = 1.0

    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_d < j_d
    b_d = b_d[keep]
    i_d = i_d[keep]
    j_d = j_d[keep]

    gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # -------- Anchor star (best -> top-gap losers).
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap_to_best = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap_to_best > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap_to_best, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_a = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # -------- Budgeting.
    if max_pairs_total is not None and max_pairs_total > 0:
        anchor_budget = int(round(max_pairs_total * anchor_frac))
        if anchor_budget < 0:
            anchor_budget = 0
        if anchor_budget > max_pairs_total:
            anchor_budget = max_pairs_total
        dense_budget = max_pairs_total - anchor_budget

        # Cap anchors by raw gap (already high-signal).
        if anchor_budget <= 0:
            b_a = b_a[:0]
            i_a = i_a[:0]
            j_a = j_a[:0]
            gap_a = gap_a[:0]
        elif b_a.numel() > anchor_budget:
            vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_a, k=anchor_budget, largest=True, sorted=False)
            ok = vals.isfinite()
            sel = sel[ok]
            b_a = b_a[sel]
            i_a = i_a[sel]
            j_a = j_a[sel]
            gap_a = gap_a[sel]

        # Dense: per-instance quantile filter on gap, then global topk on normalized gap.
        if dense_budget <= 0:
            b_d = b_d[:0]
            i_d = i_d[:0]
            j_d = j_d[:0]
            gap_d = gap_d[:0]
        elif b_d.numel() > 0:
            # Per-instance thresholds: quantile over winners' positive gaps only.
            # Build per-instance gap list in [B, Pmax] with -inf padding.
            counts = torch.bincount(b_d, minlength=B)
            Pmax = int(counts.max().item()) if B > 0 else 0
            if Pmax > 0:
                neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
                gmat = objective.new_full((B, Pmax), neg_inf)
                # Compute positions within each batch via stable sort by b_d.
                order = torch.argsort(b_d)
                b_s = b_d[order]
                i_s = i_d[order]
                j_s = j_d[order]
                g_s = gap_d[order]

                new_grp = torch.ones(b_s.numel(), dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
                if b_s.numel() > 1:
                    new_grp[1:] = b_s[1:] != b_s[:-1]
                grp = new_grp.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1  # group id in sorted-by-b

                starts = torch.zeros(B, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
                if B > 1:
                    starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
                pos = torch.arange(b_s.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts[b_s]

                gmat[b_s, pos] = g_s

                thr = torch.quantile(gmat, dense_keep_q, dim=1)  # (B,)
                thr = thr.where(counts > 0, thr.new_full((), float('inf')))

                keep_q = gap_d >= thr[b_d]
                b_d = b_d[keep_q]
                i_d = i_d[keep_q]
                j_d = j_d[keep_q]
                gap_d = gap_d[keep_q]

            # Normalize gaps for stable global topk.
            if b_d.numel() > dense_budget and dense_budget > 0:
                mean = gap_d.mean()
                var = (gap_d - mean).pow(2).mean()
                std = (var + eps).sqrt()
                gnorm = (gap_d - mean) / (std + eps)
                gnorm = gnorm.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

                vals, sel = torch.topk(gnorm, k=dense_budget, largest=True, sorted=False)
                ok = vals.isfinite()
                sel = sel[ok]
                b_d = b_d[sel]
                i_d = i_d[sel]
                j_d = j_d[sel]

    # Concatenate dense + anchor.
    if b_a.numel() > 0:
        b_out = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
        i_out = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
        j_out = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)
    else:
        b_out, i_out, j_out = b_d, i_d, j_d

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_out, i_out, j_out),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_quantile_topk_normgap',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total) if max_pairs_total is not None else 0,
            'anchor_k': int(anchor_k),
            'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap),
            'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac),
            'dense_keep_q': float(dense_keep_q),
            'gap_clip': float(gap_clip),
        },
    )

g_ir.intuition: All-pairs builder with tie-zone filtering and symmetric dedup, plus an explicit per-instance cap to prevent any single instance from dominating the batch; uses stable gap normalization and clamping while preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better).
    better = oi < oj

    # Constraint: tie-zone filter.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Constraint: de-duplicate symmetric pairs by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Gap for scoring/capping; normalize and clamp for stability.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
    mean = gap.mean()
    var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
    std = (var + eps).sqrt()
    gap_n = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
    gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Constraint: per-instance top-k cap to avoid one instance dominating pair volume.
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:
        # Score matrix (B, N, N) for masked pairs; fill invalid with -inf.
        score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if flat.shape[1] > 0:
            k_eff = k_eff if k_eff < flat.shape[1] else flat.shape[1]
        vals, idx = flat.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)

        # Keep only valid (non -inf) selections.
        valid = vals.isfinite()
        b2 = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos = idx[valid]
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N

        b_idx = b2
        i_idx = i2
        j_idx = j2

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_instcap_norm', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance) if max_pairs_per_instance is not None else 0, 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

g_ir.intuition: Paradigm shift from dense/all-pairs+anchor-star to local rank-band neighborhoods: compare each candidate only to nearby worse neighbors (hard negatives) in objective rank, emphasizing boundary refinements while keeping pair count linear in N.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    band_width = int(hp.get('band_width', 4))  # number of worse neighbors per item
    w_eps = float(hp.get('w_eps', 1e-12))
    w_max = float(hp.get('w_max', 1.0e6))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if N <= 1 or band_width <= 0:
        b0 = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        i0 = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        j0 = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w0 = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b0, i0, j0), weight=w0, meta={'builder': 'rankband_local_hardneg_normw', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band_width': int(band_width)})

    # Rank each instance by objective (lower is better).
    order = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, stable=True)  # (B,N)

    # For each rank position r, pair item at r (winner) against items at ranks r+1..r+K (losers).
    K = band_width
    if K > (N - 1):
        K = N - 1

    r = torch.arange(N, device=device, dtype=torch.long)  # (N,)
    offs = torch.arange(1, K + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.long)  # (K,)
    r_win = r[:, None].expand(N, K)  # (N,K)
    r_los = (r[:, None] + offs[None, :])  # (N,K)

    valid = r_los < N  # (N,K)

    # Map rank positions to original indices.
    win_idx_mat = order[:, r_win]  # (B,N,K)
    los_idx_mat = order[:, torch.clamp(r_los, 0, N - 1)]  # (B,N,K)

    # Broadcast valid to batch.
    valid_b = valid[None, :, :].expand(B, N, K)  # (B,N,K)

    # Tie-zone filter based on actual objective gap.
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, win_idx_mat.reshape(B, N * K)).reshape(B, N, K)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, los_idx_mat.reshape(B, N * K)).reshape(B, N, K)
    gap = obj_l - obj_w  # (B,N,K)

    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        valid_b = valid_b & (gap > tie_eps)
    else:
        valid_b = valid_b & (gap > 0)

    # Flatten to pair list.
    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None, None].expand(B, N, K)
    b_idx = b_grid[valid_b]
    i_idx = win_idx_mat[valid_b]
    j_idx = los_idx_mat[valid_b]

    # Nonnegative weights from local gap; normalize to keep scale stable.
    w = torch.clamp(gap[valid_b], 0.0, w_max)
    denom = w.sum() + w_eps
    w = w / denom

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=w, meta={'builder': 'rankband_local_hardneg_normw', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band_width': int(band_width), 'w_max': float(w_max)})

g_ir.name: builder_rankband_disagree_weighted
g_ir.intuition: Paradigm shift from dense/anchor-star to sparse rank-band pairing that targets local, informative comparisons: pair adjacent ranks and near-neighbors within a band, prefer pairs with larger objective gaps, and optionally upweight pairs where the model log_prob ordering disagrees with objective ordering.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache.get('log_prob', None)
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    band = int(hp.get('band', 2))  # neighborhood size in rank space
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))  # 0 => keep all candidates

    # Weight shaping
    w_gap_temp = float(hp.get('w_gap_temp', 1.0))
    w_disagree = float(hp.get('w_disagree', 1.0))
    w_clip = float(hp.get('w_clip', 50.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if N <= 1:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w, meta={'builder': 'rankband_disagree_weighted', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band': int(band), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance)})

    if band < 1:
        band = 1
    if band > (N - 1):
        band = N - 1

    # Rank items by objective (lower is better).
    perm = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, stable=True)  # (B,N)
    rank = torch.empty_like(perm)
    rank.scatter_(1, perm, torch.arange(N, device=device, dtype=perm.dtype)[None, :].expand(B, N))

    # Candidate edges: for each item i, compare to the next `band` worse ranks (j = r+1..r+band).
    r = torch.arange(N, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    dr = torch.arange(1, band + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    r_j = (r[None, :] + dr[:, None]).reshape(-1)  # (N*band,)
    r_i = r.repeat(band)  # (N*band,)

    valid = r_j < N
    r_i = r_i[valid]
    r_j = r_j[valid]

    # Map rank positions back to original indices.
    b_mat = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None]
    i_idx = perm[:, r_i]  # (B,P)
    j_idx = perm[:, r_j]  # (B,P)

    # Winner/loser by objective rank construction: i (better rank) beats j (worse rank).
    gap = objective.gather(1, j_idx) - objective.gather(1, i_idx)  # (B,P)

    # Tie-zone constraint.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        ok = gap > tie_eps
    else:
        ok = gap > 0.0

    # Flatten candidates.
    P = i_idx.shape[1]
    b_idx = b_mat.expand(B, P)[ok]
    w_idx = i_idx[ok]
    l_idx = j_idx[ok]
    gap_f = gap[ok]

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w, meta={'builder': 'rankband_disagree_weighted', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band': int(band), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance)})

    # Optional weighting: gap-based emphasis, plus extra weight when model disagrees with objective.
    # Disagreement means model prefers loser over winner (log_prob higher for loser).
    if log_prob is not None:
        lpw = log_prob[b_idx, w_idx]
        lpl = log_prob[b_idx, l_idx]
        disagree = (lpl > lpw).to(objective.dtype)
    else:
        disagree = gap_f.new_zeros(gap_f.shape)

    # Softplus keeps weights nonnegative and smooth.
    w_gap = torch.nn.functional.softplus(w_gap_temp * gap_f)
    w_eff = w_gap * (1.0 + w_disagree * disagree)
    if w_clip > 0.0:
        w_eff = w_eff.clamp(0.0, w_clip)

    # Per-instance cap: keep top-k by gap (not by weight) within each instance.
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:
        # Pack into padded matrices per instance and take topk per row.
        ones = torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.long)
        counts = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        counts.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, ones)
        M = int(counts.max().item()) if counts.numel() > 0 else 0

        if M > 0:
            # Sort by instance then by descending gap.
            s1 = torch.argsort(-gap_f, stable=True)
            b_s = b_idx[s1]
            w_s = w_idx[s1]
            l_s = l_idx[s1]
            g_s = gap_f[s1]
            we_s = w_eff[s1]

            w_s = w_s[s2]
            l_s = l_s[s2]
            g_s = g_s[s2]
            we_s = we_s[s2]

            # slot = idx - first_index_of_b

            w_mat = torch.zeros((B, M), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            l_mat = torch.zeros((B, M), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
            we_mat = objective.new_zeros((B, M))

            ss = slot[in_range]
            score_mat[bb, ss] = g_s[in_range]
            w_mat[bb, ss] = w_s[in_range]
            l_mat[bb, ss] = l_s[in_range]
            we_mat[bb, ss] = we_s[in_range]

    w_eff = torch.clamp(w_eff, 0.0, w_clip if w_clip > 0.0 else w_eff.max() + eps)

g_ir.intuition: All-pairs builder with tie-zone filtering and symmetric de-dup, then an explicit per-winner-row top-k constraint to cap outgoing edges per candidate (in addition to optional per-instance cap); uses stable gap normalization and clamping while preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    max_out_per_item = int(hp.get('max_out_per_item', 0))  # 0 => uncapped per (b,i) row
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better).
    better = oi < oj

    # Constraint: tie-zone filter.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Constraint: de-duplicate symmetric pairs by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Gap for scoring; normalize and clamp for stability.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
    if gap.numel() > 0:
        mean = gap.mean()
        var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
        std = (var + eps).sqrt()
        gap_n = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
    else:
        gap_n = gap
    gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Explicit constraint: cap outgoing edges per winner row (b,i) to prevent a single item
    # from dominating within an instance.
    if max_out_per_item is not None and max_out_per_item > 0 and N > 0:
        score_row = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score_row[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

        k_row = max_out_per_item if max_out_per_item < N else N
        vals_r, idx_r = score_row.topk(k_row, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B,N,k)
        valid_r = vals_r.isfinite()

        bi = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        ii = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[1]
        kk = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[2]
        jj = idx_r[bi, ii, kk]

        b_idx = bi
        i_idx = ii
        j_idx = jj

        gap_sel = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        if gap_sel.numel() > 0:
            mean2 = gap_sel.mean()
            var2 = (gap_sel - mean2).pow(2).mean()
            std2 = (var2 + eps).sqrt()
            gap_n = (gap_sel - mean2) / (std2 + eps)
        else:
            gap_n = gap_sel
        gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Constraint: per-instance top-k cap to avoid one instance dominating pair volume.
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:
        score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if flat.shape[1] > 0:
            k_eff = k_eff if k_eff < flat.shape[1] else flat.shape[1]
        vals, idx = flat.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)

        valid = vals.isfinite()
        b2 = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos = idx[valid]
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N

        b_idx = b2
        i_idx = i2
        j_idx = j2

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_rowcap_norm', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_out_per_item': int(max_out_per_item) if max_out_per_item is not None else 0, 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance) if max_pairs_per_instance is not None else 0, 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

g_ir.intuition: Pairwise per-anchor hard-negative mining: select up to k strongest (largest objective-gap) winners-over-losers per instance, while optionally dropping near-ties and enforcing a minimum gap to reduce ambiguous supervision and keep pair counts bounded.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    # Cap per anchor to avoid quadratic blow-up.
    k = int(hp.get('topk_per_anchor', extra.get('topk_per_anchor', 8) if extra is not None else 8))
    # Optional ambiguity controls.
    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', extra.get('tie_eps', 0.0) if extra is not None else 0.0))
    min_gap = float(hp.get('min_gap', extra.get('min_gap', 0.0) if extra is not None else 0.0))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better).
    better = oi < oj

    # Drop near-ties if requested.
    if tie_eps is not None and tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    # Enforce a minimum gap if requested.
    if min_gap is not None and min_gap > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) >= min_gap)

    # Score candidate pairs by objective gap; invalid pairs get -inf so they won't be selected.
    gap = oj - oi  # [B, i, j]
    neg_inf = gap.new_full(gap.shape, float('-inf'))
    score = gap.where(better, neg_inf)

    # Select up to k losers per winner-anchor i.
    k_eff = int(k)
    if k_eff <= 0:
        k_eff = 1
    if k_eff > N:
        k_eff = N

    top_score, top_j = score.topk(k_eff, dim=2, largest=True)
    valid = top_score.isfinite()

    # Build pair indices (b, winner_i, loser_j) for valid selections.
    b_idx, winner_i, kk = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    loser_j = top_j[b_idx, winner_i, kk]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_i, loser_j),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'topk_per_anchor_gap_min_gap',
            'topk_per_anchor': int(k_eff),
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps) if tie_eps is not None else 0.0,
            'min_gap': float(min_gap) if min_gap is not None else 0.0,
        },
    )

g_ir.name: builder_allpairs_tie_anchor_perbatch_budget
g_ir.intuition: Keep the same dense + anchor-star geometry and tie/dedup constraints, but replace the single global top-k cap with a per-batch budget allocator that (1) reserves a fixed share for anchor-on-best pairs and (2) spends the remainder on the strongest all-pairs gaps using a percentile-based threshold then exact top-k if still over budget.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total pair budget (0 => uncapped). Budget is split between anchor star and dense pairs.
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))
    anchor_frac = float(hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.25))

    # Anchor controls
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    # Percentile pre-cap for dense pairs (only used when max_pairs_total > 0)
    # Keep pairs with gap >= quantile(gap, q). q in [0,1].
    dense_keep_q = float(hp.get('dense_keep_q', 0.85))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup by keeping one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Compute dense pair gaps once; used for capping.
    gap_dense = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]

    # Build anchor star pairs (best beats selected losers).
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_anchor = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_anchor = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # Apply per-batch budget allocation.
    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0:
        # Clamp anchor fraction to [0,1] without relying on Python min/max for correctness.
        if anchor_frac < 0.0:
            anchor_frac = 0.0
        if anchor_frac > 1.0:
            anchor_frac = 1.0

        anchor_budget = int(round(max_pairs_total * anchor_frac))
        if anchor_budget < 0:
            anchor_budget = 0
        if anchor_budget > max_pairs_total:
            anchor_budget = max_pairs_total
        dense_budget = max_pairs_total - anchor_budget

        # Cap anchor pairs by strongest gaps if needed.
        if b_a.numel() > anchor_budget and anchor_budget > 0:
            vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_anchor, k=anchor_budget, largest=True, sorted=False)
            ok = vals.isfinite()
            sel = sel[ok]
            b_a = b_a[sel]
            i_a = i_a[sel]
            j_a = j_a[sel]
            gap_anchor = gap_anchor[sel]
        elif anchor_budget == 0:
            b_a = b_a[:0]
            i_a = i_a[:0]
            j_a = j_a[:0]
            gap_anchor = gap_anchor[:0]

        # Dense: percentile pre-cap then strict top-k to dense_budget.
        if dense_budget <= 0:
            b_idx = b_idx[:0]
            i_idx = i_idx[:0]
            j_idx = j_idx[:0]
            gap_dense = gap_dense[:0]
        else:
            if b_idx.numel() > dense_budget and b_idx.numel() > 0:
                q = dense_keep_q
                if q < 0.0:
                    q = 0.0
                if q > 1.0:
                    q = 1.0
                # quantile over produced dense gaps (global across batch), then keep those above threshold.
                thr = torch.quantile(gap_dense, q)
                m = gap_dense >= thr
                b_idx = b_idx[m]
                i_idx = i_idx[m]
                j_idx = j_idx[m]
                gap_dense = gap_dense[m]

            if b_idx.numel() > dense_budget and dense_budget > 0:
                vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_dense, k=dense_budget, largest=True, sorted=False)
                ok = vals.isfinite()
                sel = sel[ok]
                b_idx = b_idx[sel]
                i_idx = i_idx[sel]
                j_idx = j_idx[sel]
                gap_dense = gap_dense[sel]

    # Concatenate dense + anchor.
    if b_a.numel() > 0:
        b_out = torch.cat([b_idx, b_a], dim=0)
        i_out = torch.cat([i_idx, i_a], dim=0)
        j_out = torch.cat([j_idx, j_a], dim=0)
    else:
        b_out, i_out, j_out = b_idx, i_idx, j_idx

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_out, i_out, j_out),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_perbatch_budget',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total),
            'anchor_k': int(anchor_k),
            'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap),
            'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac),
            'dense_keep_q': float(dense_keep_q),
        },
    )

g_ir.intuition: Dense all-pairs with tie-zone filtering and symmetric de-dup, but replace the hard per-instance top-k cap with a percentile-based per-instance cap: keep only pairs whose normalized gap exceeds a within-instance quantile threshold, yielding an adaptive budget that scales with instance difficulty while preserving stable normalization/clamping and pairwise PrefBatch output.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Percentile cap within each batch element.
    # keep_quantile in (0,1]: keep pairs with gap_n >= quantile(gap_n, keep_quantile).
    # 1.0 => keep all; 0.9 => keep top 10% by normalized gap per instance.
    keep_quantile = float(hp.get('keep_quantile', 1.0))

    # Optional hard fallback cap after percentile (0 => uncapped). Helps bound worst-case.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))

    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better).
    better = oi < oj

    # Constraint: tie-zone filter.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Constraint: de-duplicate symmetric pairs by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_pctcap_norm', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'keep_quantile': float(keep_quantile), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance), 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

    # Gap for scoring; normalize and clamp for stability.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
    mean = gap.mean()
    var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
    std = (var + eps).sqrt()
    gap_n = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
    gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Build per-instance padded matrix of candidate scores for quantile selection.
    # Fill invalid entries with +inf so they do not pass gap_n >= threshold.
    score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('inf'))
    score[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

    # Percentile-based cap per instance.
    if keep_quantile is not None and keep_quantile < 1.0:
        q = keep_quantile
        if q < 0.0:
            q = 0.0
        if q > 1.0:
            q = 1.0

        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        fin = flat.isfinite()
        cnt = fin.sum(dim=1)

        # Compute per-row k corresponding to the (1-q) tail (top tail).
        # k_keep = ceil((1-q)*cnt). If k_keep==0 => keep none; if k_keep>=cnt => keep all.
        tail = (1.0 - q)
        k_keep = ops.ceil(cnt.to(objective.dtype) * objective.new_tensor(tail)).to(dtype=cnt.dtype)
        k_keep = ops.clamp(k_keep, 0, cnt)

        # Replace +inf with -inf for topk; then take per-row topk with k_max.
        flat2 = ops.where(fin, flat, objective.new_full((), float('-inf')))
        k_max = int(k_keep.max().item()) if B > 0 else 0

        if k_max > 0:
            vals, idx = flat2.topk(k_max, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
            # Mark valid selections per row based on its k_keep.
            ar = ops.arange(k_max, device=objective.device)[None, :]
            take = ar < k_keep[:, None]
            take = take & vals.isfinite()

            b2, t2 = take.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
            pos = idx[b2, t2]
            i2 = pos // N
            j2 = pos - i2 * N

            b_idx = b2
            i_idx = i2
            j_idx = j2
        else:
            b_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=ops.int64)
            i_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=ops.int64)
            j_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=ops.int64)

    # Optional hard cap per instance after percentile cap (still vectorized).
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        # Recompute normalized gaps for current set (cheap gather).
        gap2 = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        gap2_n = (gap2 - mean) / (std + eps)
        gap2_n = gap2_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

        # Scatter into (B,N,N) and topk per row.
        score2 = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score2[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap2_n
        flat3 = score2.reshape(B, N * N)

        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if flat3.shape[1] > 0:
            k_eff = k_eff if k_eff < flat3.shape[1] else flat3.shape[1]
        vals3, idx3 = flat3.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        valid3 = vals3.isfinite()
        b3 = valid3.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos3 = idx3[valid3]
        i3 = pos3 // N
        j3 = pos3 - i3 * N

        b_idx = b3
        i_idx = i3
        j_idx = j3

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_pctcap_norm', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'keep_quantile': float(keep_quantile), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance) if max_pairs_per_instance is not None else 0, 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):

    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]

        winner_idx = winner_idx[keep]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[keep]

    return PrefBatch(

        weight=None,
        meta={

g_ir.intuition: Combine stable dense supervision (all strict objective-improving pairs with tie-zone filtering and symmetric dedup) with a small, high-signal anchor-on-best star (top-gap losers) to control pair count while keeping strong directional constraints away from near-ties.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    # Tie-zone (avoid ambiguous near-equal comparisons)
    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Pair budget controls (keep it simple: global cap + small anchor supplement)
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))  # 0 => no anchor supplement
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # De-duplicate symmetric duplicates by enforcing i < j (keeps one directed edge per unordered pair).
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Optional: add compact anchor-on-best star for extra high-gap signal.
    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_idx2 = b2[picked]
        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]

        # Concatenate; allow duplicates (fine; downstream loss typically tolerates), rely on global cap if needed.
        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    # Optional global cap by selecting largest objective gaps among produced pairs (vectorized).
    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        # Prefer stronger, clearer preferences.
        vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_pairs, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
        ok = vals.isfinite()
        sel = sel[ok]
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        i_idx = i_idx[sel]
        j_idx = j_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_mixcap', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Per-anchor budget: allocate a (roughly) even budget across winners (anchors).
    # If max_pairs_total<=0, no cap is applied.
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    per_anchor_cap = int(hp.get('per_anchor_cap', 0))    # 0 => derive from max_pairs_total

    # Optional: add compact anchor-on-best star for extra high-gap signal.
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))  # 0 => no anchor supplement
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # De-duplicate symmetric duplicates by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Optional: anchor-on-best star (best -> top-gap losers).
    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_idx2 = b2[picked]
        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]

        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    # Per-anchor (per winner) budget cap.
    # Anchor key is (batch_instance, winner_index). We keep up to K strongest gaps per anchor.
    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        # Derive a default per-anchor cap if not provided.
        if per_anchor_cap <= 0:
            # Distribute total budget across all possible anchors (B*N) with at least 1 per anchor.
            denom = int(B * N) if int(B * N) > 0 else 1
            per_anchor_cap = max(1, int((max_pairs_total + denom - 1) // denom))

        # Score = objective gap between loser and winner.
        gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]

        # Flatten (b,i) into a single anchor id.
        anchor_id = b_idx * N + i_idx  # (P,)
        P = anchor_id.numel()

        # Stable grouping by anchor id via sort; then do per-group topk without Python loops.
        order = torch.argsort(anchor_id)
        anchor_s = anchor_id[order]
        b_s = b_idx[order]
        i_s = i_idx[order]
        j_s = j_idx[order]
        gap_s = gap_pairs[order]

        # Identify group boundaries.
        new_group = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P > 1:
            new_group[1:] = anchor_s[1:] != anchor_s[:-1]
        group_id = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1  # (P,)
        G = int(group_id[-1].item()) + 1

        # Position within each group (0..len-1) using scatter-add trick.
        pos = torch.zeros(P, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        ones = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = counts.scatter_add(0, group_id, ones)
        # Compute prefix starts per group, then pos = arange - start[group]
        starts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        if G > 1:
            starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos = torch.arange(P, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts[group_id]

        # Keep candidates up to a window size per group to allow selecting top gaps.
        # First, mask by per_anchor_cap (pre-window).
        in_window = pos < per_anchor_cap

        # Within window, we still want strongest gaps; do this by sorting within each group by (-gap).
        # Build a lexicographic key: (group_id, -gap) using a secondary sort on gap.
        # We approximate lexicographic sort by sorting by a composite float key.
        # Note: group_id is integer; scale ensures group separation dominates.

        i_c = i_s[comp_order]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total budget across all instances (0 => uncapped).
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))

    # Per-instance cap (0 => derive from max_pairs_total / B).
    per_instance_cap = int(hp.get('per_instance_cap', 0))

    # Optional: reserve a share of each instance budget for anchor-star pairs.
    anchor_frac = float(hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.25))

    # Anchor controls (best -> top-gap losers).
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup by keeping one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_d < j_d
    b_d = b_d[keep]
    i_d = i_d[keep]
    j_d = j_d[keep]

    gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Anchor star pairs.
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_a = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # If uncapped, just return combined pairs.
    if not (max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0):
        if b_a.numel() > 0:
            b_idx = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
            i_idx = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
            j_idx = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)
        else:
            b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = b_d, i_d, j_d
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_perinstance_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'per_instance_cap': int(per_instance_cap), 'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

    # Derive per-instance cap if needed.

        j_c = j_s[o2]

        new2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P2 > 1:
            new2[1:] = b_c[1:] != b_c[:-1]
        group2 = new2.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        ones2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = torch.zeros(int(group2[-1].item()) + 1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = counts2.scatter_add(0, group2, ones2)
        starts2 = torch.zeros_like(counts2)
        if starts2.numel() > 1:
            starts2[1:] = counts2.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos2 = torch.arange(P2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts2[group2]

        inv = order[o2]
        keep_a.scatter_(0, inv, ka)

    keep_d = b_d.new_zeros((b_d.numel(),), dtype=torch.bool)
    if b_d.numel() > 0 and cap_d > 0:
        order = torch.argsort(b_d)
        b_s = b_d[order]
        i_s = i_d[order]
        j_s = j_d[order]
        g_s = gap_d[order]

        P = b_s.numel()
        new_group = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P > 1:
            new_group[1:] = b_s[1:] != b_s[:-1]
        group = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1

        gmin = g_s.min() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        gmax = g_s.max() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(1.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        span = (gmax - gmin).clamp(min=1.0)
        comp = group.to(g_s.dtype) * (span + 1.0) + (gmax - g_s) / (span + 1.0)
        o2 = torch.argsort(comp)

        b_c = b_s[o2]

        P2 = b_c.numel()
        new2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P2 > 1:
            new2[1:] = b_c[1:] != b_c[:-1]
        group2 = new2.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        ones2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = torch.zeros(int(group2[-1].item()) + 1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = counts2.scatter_add(0, group2, ones2)
        starts2 = torch.zeros_like(counts2)
        if starts2.numel() > 1:
            starts2[1:] = counts2.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos2 = torch.arange(P2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts2[group2]

        kd = pos2 < cap_d
        inv = order[o2]
        keep_d.scatter_(0, inv, kd)

    # Materialize selected pairs.
    b_out = torch.cat([b_d[keep_d], b_a[keep_a]], dim=0) if b_a.numel() > 0 else b_d[keep_d]
    i_out = torch.cat([i_d[keep_d], i_a[keep_a]], dim=0) if b_a.numel() > 0 else i_d[keep_d]
    j_out = torch.cat([j_d[keep_d], j_a[keep_a]], dim=0) if b_a.numel() > 0 else j_d[keep_d]

    # Final global cap safety.
    if b_out.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        gap_out = objective[b_out, j_out] - objective[b_out, i_out]
        vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_out, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
        ok = vals.isfinite()
        sel = sel[ok]
        b_out = b_out[sel]
        i_out = i_out[sel]
        j_out = j_out[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_out, i_out, j_out), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_perinstance_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'per_instance_cap': int(per_instance_cap), 'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

    # Global budget across the whole batch (0 => uncapped)
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))

    # Per-instance adaptive cap: keep pairs with gap >= quantile(gap, q) within each instance.
    # q in [0,1]. Example: q=0.75 keeps roughly top 25% by gap per instance.
    keep_gap_quantile = float(hp.get('keep_gap_quantile', 0.75))
    keep_gap_quantile = 0.0 if keep_gap_quantile < 0.0 else (1.0 if keep_gap_quantile > 1.0 else keep_gap_quantile)

    # Optional: anchor-on-best star supplement
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and outside tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # De-duplicate symmetric duplicates by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Score = objective gap between loser and winner.
    gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]

        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)

        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]
        gap2 = (objective[b_idx2, j_idx2] - objective[b_idx2, i_idx2])

        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

        gap_mat = oj - oi  # (B,N,N)

        i_idx = i_idx[keep_thr]
        j_idx = j_idx[keep_thr]
        gap_pairs = gap_pairs[keep_thr]

        i_idx = i_idx[sel]
        j_idx = j_idx[sel]
