g_ir.name: builder_allpairs_tie_anchor_percentile_cap
g_ir.intuition: Keep dense all-pairs + best-anchor star geometry with tie-zone filtering and symmetric de-dup, but replace per-instance equal budget splitting with a global percentile-based cap: keep only pairs whose objective gaps are in the top tail (separately for dense and anchor-star), producing an adaptive number of comparisons based on instance difficulty and gap distribution.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Percentile caps (0..1). Keep pairs with gaps >= quantile.
    dense_q = float(hp.get('dense_gap_quantile', 0.90))
    anchor_q = float(hp.get('anchor_gap_quantile', 0.80))

    # Optional hard backstop caps (0 => uncapped)
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))
    max_anchor_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_anchor_pairs_total', 0))

    # Anchor controls
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and outside tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_d < j_d
    b_d = b_d[keep]
    i_d = i_d[keep]
    j_d = j_d[keep]

    gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Anchor star: best beats selected losers.
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_a = top.values[picked]

    # Percentile-based cap for dense gaps (global over batch)
    if b_d.numel() > 0:
        q = dense_q
        if q < 0.0:
            q = 0.0
        if q > 1.0:
            q = 1.0
        if q > 0.0:
            k = int((1.0 - q) * float(gap_d.numel()))
            if k < 1:
                k = 1
            if k > gap_d.numel():
                k = int(gap_d.numel())
            # threshold is the k-th largest gap => top (1-q) tail
            vals = torch.topk(gap_d, k=k, largest=True, sorted=False).values
            thr = vals.min()
            keep_d = gap_d >= thr
            b_d = b_d[keep_d]
            i_d = i_d[keep_d]
            j_d = j_d[keep_d]
            gap_d = gap_d[keep_d]

    # Percentile-based cap for anchor gaps (global over batch)
    if b_a.numel() > 0:
        q = anchor_q
        if q < 0.0:
            q = 0.0
        if q > 1.0:
            q = 1.0
        if q > 0.0:
            k = int((1.0 - q) * float(gap_a.numel()))
            if k < 1:
                k = 1
            if k > gap_a.numel():
                k = int(gap_a.numel())
            vals = torch.topk(gap_a, k=k, largest=True, sorted=False).values
            thr = vals.min()
            keep_a = gap_a >= thr
            b_a = b_a[keep_a]
            i_a = i_a[keep_a]
            j_a = j_a[keep_a]
            gap_a = gap_a[keep_a]

    # Optional hard caps as a backstop
    if max_anchor_pairs_total and max_anchor_pairs_total > 0 and b_a.numel() > max_anchor_pairs_total:
        sel = torch.topk(gap_a, k=max_anchor_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_a = b_a[sel]
        i_a = i_a[sel]
        j_a = j_a[sel]
        gap_a = gap_a[sel]

    # Combine then optional global hard cap
    b_idx = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
    i_idx = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
    j_idx = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)
    gap_all = torch.cat([gap_d, gap_a], dim=0)

    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        sel = torch.topk(gap_all, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        i_idx = i_idx[sel]
        j_idx = j_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_percentile_cap', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'dense_gap_quantile': float(dense_q), 'anchor_gap_quantile': float(anchor_q), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'max_anchor_pairs_total': int(max_anchor_pairs_total), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

g_ir.name: obj_extremes_pairs_gapw_fixops
g_ir.intuition: Within each instance, construct exactly one preference by choosing the lowest-objective sample as the winner and the highest-objective sample as the loser (lower is better). Weight each pair by the (detached) nonnegative objective gap, normalized by the batch mean gap and capped, so clearer improvements get more influence without unstable spikes.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {}) if extra is not None else {}

    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    w_max = float(hp.get("w_max", 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", 1e-12))

    # Pick best (min objective) and worst (max objective) per instance.
    winner_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1).to(dtype=torch.int64)
    loser_idx = objective.argmax(dim=1).to(dtype=torch.int64)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)

    # Filter degenerate self-pairs (e.g., K==1 or all objectives tied).
    m = winner_idx != loser_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[m]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[m]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[m]

    # Detached, nonnegative gap-based weights; cap to avoid spikes.
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        weight = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    else:
        ow = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
        ol = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]
        gap = (ol - ow).detach().clamp(min=0.0)
        denom = gap.mean() + eps
        weight = (gap / denom).clamp(0.0, w_max)

    meta = {"w_max": w_max, "eps": eps, "pairing": "argmin_vs_argmax"}

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta=meta)

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    k = hp.get('topk_per_anchor', 8)

    B, N = objective.shape
    # For each anchor i, candidates j with objective[i] < objective[j].
    win_mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]

    # Score candidate pairs by objective gap; invalid pairs get -inf so they won't be selected.
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]  # [B, i, j]
    neg_inf = gap.new_full(gap.shape, float('-inf'))
    score = gap.where(win_mask, neg_inf)

    # Select up to k losers per winner-anchor i.
    k_eff = int(k)
    if k_eff <= 0:
        k_eff = 1
    if k_eff > N:
        k_eff = N

    top_score, top_j = score.topk(k_eff, dim=2, largest=True)
    valid = top_score.isfinite()

    # Build pair indices (b, winner_i, loser_j) for valid selections.
    b_idx, winner_i, kk = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    loser_j = top_j[b_idx, winner_i, kk]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_i, loser_j), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'topk_per_anchor_gap', 'topk_per_anchor': k_eff})

g_ir.name: objrank_topk_peranchor_lpweight
g_ir.intuition: Construct per-instance pairwise preferences by comparing objective ranks (lower objective wins), sampling only the most informative winners per instance (top-ranked by objective) and pairing them against a capped set of worse losers; weight pairs by a clipped softplus of the winner-vs-loser log_prob gap to emphasize confident preferences while keeping weights nonnegative and bounded.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    winners_topk = int(hp.get('winners_topk', 2))
    losers_topk = int(hp.get('losers_topk', 4))
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))  # 0 => uncapped

    # Weight shaping from log-prob gap (winner - loser): nonnegative and bounded.
    w_scale = float(hp.get('w_scale', 1.0))
    w_clip = float(hp.get('w_clip', 10.0))
    w_min = float(hp.get('w_min', 0.0))

    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if K <= 1:
        empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        w_empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w_empty, meta={'reason': 'K<=1'})

    winners_topk = max(1, min(winners_topk, K))
    losers_topk = max(1, min(losers_topk, K))

    # Ranks by objective (ascending): lower objective => better.
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # (B,K)
    win_idx = order[:, :winners_topk]  # (B,W)

    # Candidate losers: the remaining (worse) indices after winners.
    # Using only suffix keeps geometry simple and avoids comparing with better/equal ranks.
    cand_losers = order[:, winners_topk:]  # (B, K-W)
    if cand_losers.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        w_empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w_empty, meta={'reason': 'no_losers'})

    # Enforce strict improvement with optional tie-zone.
    win_obj = objective.gather(1, win_idx)  # (B,W)
    lose_obj_all = objective.gather(1, cand_losers)  # (B,Lc)
    # better[b,w,l] = lose_obj - win_obj > tie_eps
    better = (lose_obj_all[:, None, :] - win_obj[:, :, None]) > tie_eps

    # Prefer hardest (closest) losers per winner: pick smallest (lose_obj - win_obj).
    gap = lose_obj_all[:, None, :] - win_obj[:, :, None]  # (B,W,Lc)
    big = torch.tensor(1.0e9, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    gap_masked = torch.where(better, gap, big)

    # Top-k smallest gaps => topk on negative gaps.
    k_l = min(losers_topk, gap_masked.shape[-1])
    neg_gap = -gap_masked
    vals, pos = torch.topk(neg_gap, k=k_l, dim=2)  # (B,W,k_l)

    chosen_loser_idx = cand_losers[:, None, :].expand(B, winners_topk, cand_losers.shape[1]).gather(2, pos)  # (B,W,k_l)

    # Valid if it wasn't a masked-out entry.
    valid = vals > (-big / 2.0)

    # Build pair tensors.
    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)[:, None, None].expand(B, winners_topk, k_l)
    w_grid = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, winners_topk, k_l).to(torch.int64)
    l_grid = chosen_loser_idx.to(torch.int64)

    b_flat = b_grid.reshape(-1)
    w_flat = w_grid.reshape(-1)
    l_flat = l_grid.reshape(-1)
    m_flat = valid.reshape(-1)

    if m_flat.any():
        sel = m_flat
        b_sel = b_flat[sel]
        w_sel = w_flat[sel]
        l_sel = l_flat[sel]
    else:
        empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        w_empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w_empty, meta={'reason': 'no_valid_pairs'})

    # Optional global cap: keep pairs with largest objective gap (most decisive) to control count.
    if max_pairs_total > 0 and b_sel.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        ow = objective[b_sel, w_sel]
        ol = objective[b_sel, l_sel]
        ogap = (ol - ow)
        kk = max_pairs_total
        _, keep_idx = torch.topk(ogap, k=kk, dim=0)
        b_sel = b_sel[keep_idx]
        w_sel = w_sel[keep_idx]
        l_sel = l_sel[keep_idx]

    # Weights from log-prob gap.
    lpw = log_prob[b_sel, w_sel]
    lpl = log_prob[b_sel, l_sel]
    lp_gap = (lpw - lpl) * w_scale
    w = ops.softplus(lp_gap)
    if w_clip > 0.0:
        w = ops.clamp(w, 0.0, w_clip)
    if w_min > 0.0:
        w = ops.clamp(w, w_min, 1.0e9)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_sel.to(torch.int64), w_sel.to(torch.int64), l_sel.to(torch.int64)),
        weight=w,
        meta={
            'tie_eps': tie_eps,
            'winners_topk': winners_topk,
            'losers_topk': losers_topk,
            'max_pairs_total': max_pairs_total,
            'weight_family': 'softplus_logprob_gap_clipped'
        }
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    # Minimum objective improvement required to emit a preference.
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', hp.get('gap_threshold', 1.0e-3)))
    # Global cap across the whole batch.
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', hp.get('max_pairs', 256)))

    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]

        meta={

g_ir.name: builder_rankband_neighbor_weighted
g_ir.intuition: Paradigm shift from dense all-pairs+anchor-star to a sparse rank-band neighborhood graph: compare each candidate only to nearby-ranked neighbors within a band, with nonnegative weights emphasizing harder near-tie comparisons (small objective gaps).
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    band = int(hp.get('band', 4))
    max_degree = int(hp.get('max_degree', 8))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))
    w_clip = float(hp.get('w_clip', 1000000.0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if N <= 1:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w, meta={'builder': 'rankband_neighbor_weighted', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'band': int(band), 'max_degree': int(max_degree)})

    # Sort items by objective (lower is better). Rank positions define the neighborhood graph.
    # perm: (B,N) maps rank->item index.
    perm = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, descending=False)

    # Build rank offsets in [-band, ..., -1, 1, ..., band].
    band_eff = band
    if band_eff < 1:
        band_eff = 1
    if band_eff > (N - 1):
        band_eff = N - 1

    offs = torch.arange(-band_eff, band_eff + 1, device=device)
    offs = offs[offs != 0]  # (K,)
    K = int(offs.numel())

    # Optionally cap degree by taking a centered subset of offsets.
    if max_degree is not None and max_degree > 0 and K > max_degree:
        # Keep the closest neighbors: [-d..-1, 1..d]
        d = max_degree // 2
        if d < 1:
            d = 1
        if d > band_eff:
            d = band_eff
        offs = torch.arange(-d, d + 1, device=device)
        offs = offs[offs != 0]
        K = int(offs.numel())

    # For each rank position r, pair with rank position r+off (clamped to [0, N-1]).
    r = torch.arange(N, device=device)[None, :, None]  # (1,N,1)
    rr = r + offs[None, None, :]  # (1,N,K)
    rr = rr.clamp(0, N - 1)

    b = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None, None]  # (B,1,1)
    b = b.expand(B, N, K)  # (B,N,K)

    # Winner/loser determined by objective: lower objective wins.
    i_item = perm[b, r.expand(B, N, K)]  # (B,N,K)
    j_item = perm[b, rr.expand(B, N, K)]  # (B,N,K)

    oi = objective.gather(1, i_item.reshape(B, N * K)).reshape(B, N, K)
    oj = objective.gather(1, j_item.reshape(B, N * K)).reshape(B, N, K)

    # Enforce strict preference direction and tie-zone filter; drop self-edges.
    win_i = oi < oj
    win_j = oj < oi
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        win_i = win_i & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)
        win_j = win_j & ((oi - oj) > tie_eps)

    not_self = i_item != j_item
    win_i = win_i & not_self
    win_j = win_j & not_self

    # Flatten and select edges.
    b_flat = b.reshape(B * N * K)
    i_flat = i_item.reshape(B * N * K)
    j_flat = j_item.reshape(B * N * K)
    oi_flat = oi.reshape(B * N * K)
    oj_flat = oj.reshape(B * N * K)

    m_i = win_i.reshape(B * N * K)
    m_j = win_j.reshape(B * N * K)

    b_i = b_flat[m_i]
    w_i = i_flat[m_i]
    l_i = j_flat[m_i]
    gap_i = (oj_flat[m_i] - oi_flat[m_i])

    b_j = b_flat[m_j]
    w_j = j_flat[m_j]
    l_j = i_flat[m_j]
    gap_j = (oi_flat[m_j] - oj_flat[m_j])

    b_out = torch.cat([b_i, b_j], dim=0)
    w_out = torch.cat([w_i, w_j], dim=0)
    l_out = torch.cat([l_i, l_j], dim=0)
    gap_out = torch.cat([gap_i, gap_j], dim=0)

    # Nonnegative weights emphasize harder comparisons (smaller gap => larger weight).
    # Weight is clipped for safety and remains nonnegative.
    w = 1.0 / (gap_out.abs() + eps)
    if w_clip is not None and w_clip > 0.0:
        w = w.clamp(0.0, w_clip)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_out, w_out, l_out),
        weight=w,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rankband_neighbor_weighted',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'band': int(band),
            'max_degree': int(max_degree),
            'weight_eps': float(eps),
            'w_clip': float(w_clip),
        },
    )

g_ir.intuition: Combine stable dense supervision (all strict objective-improving pairs with tie-zone filtering and symmetric dedup) with a small, high-signal anchor-on-best star (top-gap losers) to control pair count while keeping strong directional constraints away from near-ties.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    # Tie-zone (avoid ambiguous near-equal comparisons)
    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Pair budget controls (keep it simple: global cap + small anchor supplement)
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))  # 0 => no anchor supplement
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # De-duplicate symmetric duplicates by enforcing i < j (keeps one directed edge per unordered pair).
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Optional: add compact anchor-on-best star for extra high-gap signal.
    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_idx2 = b2[picked]
        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]

        # Concatenate; allow duplicates (fine; downstream loss typically tolerates), rely on global cap if needed.
        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    # Optional global cap by selecting largest objective gaps among produced pairs (vectorized).
    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        # Prefer stronger, clearer preferences.
        vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_pairs, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
        ok = vals.isfinite()
        sel = sel[ok]
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        i_idx = i_idx[sel]
        j_idx = j_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_mixcap', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    # Per-anchor (per winner) budget cap.
    # Anchor key is (batch_instance, winner_index). We keep up to K strongest gaps per anchor.
    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        # Derive a default per-anchor cap if not provided.
        if per_anchor_cap <= 0:
            # Distribute total budget across all possible anchors (B*N) with at least 1 per anchor.
            denom = int(B * N) if int(B * N) > 0 else 1
            per_anchor_cap = max(1, int((max_pairs_total + denom - 1) // denom))

        # Score = objective gap between loser and winner.
        gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]

        # Flatten (b,i) into a single anchor id.
        anchor_id = b_idx * N + i_idx  # (P,)
        P = anchor_id.numel()

        # Stable grouping by anchor id via sort; then do per-group topk without Python loops.
        order = torch.argsort(anchor_id)
        anchor_s = anchor_id[order]
        b_s = b_idx[order]
        i_s = i_idx[order]
        j_s = j_idx[order]
        gap_s = gap_pairs[order]

        # Identify group boundaries.
        new_group = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P > 1:
            new_group[1:] = anchor_s[1:] != anchor_s[:-1]
        group_id = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1  # (P,)
        G = int(group_id[-1].item()) + 1

        # Position within each group (0..len-1) using scatter-add trick.
        pos = torch.zeros(P, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        ones = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = counts.scatter_add(0, group_id, ones)
        # Compute prefix starts per group, then pos = arange - start[group]
        starts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        if G > 1:
            starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos = torch.arange(P, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts[group_id]

        # Keep candidates up to a window size per group to allow selecting top gaps.
        # First, mask by per_anchor_cap (pre-window).
        in_window = pos < per_anchor_cap

        # Within window, we still want strongest gaps; do this by sorting within each group by (-gap).
        # Build a lexicographic key: (group_id, -gap) using a secondary sort on gap.
        # We approximate lexicographic sort by sorting by a composite float key.
        # Note: group_id is integer; scale ensures group separation dominates.
        gap_min = gap_s.min() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        gap_max = gap_s.max() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(1.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        span = (gap_max - gap_min).clamp(min=1.0)
        comp = group_id.to(gap_s.dtype) * (span + 1.0) + (gap_max - gap_s) / (span + 1.0)
        comp_order = torch.argsort(comp)

        anchor_c = anchor_s[comp_order]
        b_c = b_s[comp_order]
        i_c = i_s[comp_order]
        j_c = j_s[comp_order]
        gap_c = gap_s[comp_order]

        # Recompute group_id/pos after comp sort.
        P2 = anchor_c.numel()
        new_group2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P2 > 1:
            new_group2[1:] = anchor_c[1:] != anchor_c[:-1]
        group2 = new_group2.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        G2 = int(group2[-1].item()) + 1

        ones2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = torch.zeros(G2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = counts2.scatter_add(0, group2, ones2)
        starts2 = torch.zeros(G2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        if G2 > 1:
            starts2[1:] = counts2.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos2 = torch.arange(P2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts2[group2]

        keep2 = pos2 < per_anchor_cap

        b_kept = b_c[keep2]
        i_kept = i_c[keep2]
        j_kept = j_c[keep2]
        gap_kept = gap_c[keep2]

        # If still over global budget, apply a final global topk on gap.
        if b_kept.numel() > max_pairs_total:
            vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_kept, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
            ok = vals.isfinite()
            sel = sel[ok]
            b_kept = b_kept[sel]
            i_kept = i_kept[sel]
            j_kept = j_kept[sel]

        b_idx = b_kept
        i_idx = i_kept
        j_idx = j_kept

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_peranchor_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'per_anchor_cap': int(per_anchor_cap), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]

    hp = extra.get("hyperparams", {}) if extra is not None else {}

    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    w_max = float(hp.get("w_max", 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get("eps", 1e-12))

    # Pick best (min objective) and worst (max objective) per instance.
    winner_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1).to(dtype=torch.int64)
    loser_idx = objective.argmax(dim=1).to(dtype=torch.int64)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)

    # Filter degenerate self-pairs (e.g., K==1 or all objectives tied).
    m = winner_idx != loser_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[m]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[m]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[m]

    # Detached, nonnegative gap-based weights; cap to avoid spikes.
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        weight = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    else:
        ow = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
        ol = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]
        gap = (ol - ow).detach().clamp(min=0.0)
        denom = gap.mean() + eps
        weight = (gap / denom).clamp(0.0, w_max)

    meta = {"w_max": w_max, "eps": eps, "pairing": "argmin_vs_argmax"}

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta=meta)

g_ir.intuition: pairwise: allocate a single global budget of hardest (largest objective gap) preference pairs across the whole batch, rather than a fixed top-k per anchor; adapts pair count to instance difficulty while capping total work
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    budget = hp.get('pair_budget', 1024)

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Strict preference direction (lower objective is better): i beats j if oi < oj.
    win_mask = oi < oj  # [B, i, j]

    # Score pairs by objective gap (hardness/strength). Invalid pairs get -inf.
    gap = oj - oi  # [B, i, j]
    neg_inf = gap.new_full(gap.shape, float('-inf'))
    score = gap.where(win_mask, neg_inf)

    # Flatten all candidate pairs and pick global top-budget.
    score_flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)  # includes i==j and invalids as -inf

    b_eff = int(budget)
    if b_eff <= 0:
        b_eff = 1
    max_pairs = int(N * N)
    if b_eff > max_pairs:
        b_eff = max_pairs

    top_score, top_flat = score_flat.topk(b_eff, dim=1, largest=True)
    valid = top_score.isfinite()  # [B, b_eff]

    # Convert flat indices back to (i, j) and pack valid pairs.
    i_idx = (top_flat // N).to(dtype=top_flat.dtype)
    j_idx = (top_flat - i_idx * N).to(dtype=top_flat.dtype)

    b_idx = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=False)[:, 0]
    kk = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=False)[:, 1]

    winner_i = i_idx[b_idx, kk]
    loser_j = j_idx[b_idx, kk]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_i, loser_j), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'global_budget_topk_gap', 'pair_budget': b_eff})

g_ir.name: rankstar_band_gapcap
g_ir.intuition: Construct strict-improvement pairs by ranking candidates per instance and pairing each top-ranked winner with a small band of worse-ranked losers (rank-band star). Weight pairs by a clipped objective gap so larger improvements contribute more while controlling outliers and keeping pair counts bounded.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    band = int(hp.get('band', 4))
    max_winners = int(hp.get('max_winners', 8))
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 128))
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    weight_min = float(hp.get('weight_min', 1e-4))

    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if K <= 1:
        empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=empty.to(objective.dtype), meta={'reason': 'K<=1'})

    if band < 1:
        band = 1
    if max_winners < 1:
        max_winners = 1

    # Rank candidates per instance (lower objective is better).
    rank = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # (B,K)

    # Winner positions are the top ranks [0..W-1].
    W = min(max_winners, K - 1)
    winner_pos = torch.arange(W, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)[None, :]  # (1,W)
    winner_idx = rank[:, :W]  # (B,W)

    # Loser positions are a fixed offset band below each winner position.
    offs = torch.arange(1, band + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)[None, None, :]  # (1,1,band)
    loser_pos = winner_pos[:, :, None] + offs  # (1,W,band)
    loser_pos = loser_pos.expand(B, W, band)  # (B,W,band)
    valid = loser_pos < K

    # Gather loser indices.
    loser_pos_safe = torch.where(valid, loser_pos, torch.zeros_like(loser_pos))
    loser_idx = rank.gather(1, loser_pos_safe.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, W, band)

    # Compute strict-improvement mask and gap-based weights.
    ow = objective.gather(1, winner_idx)  # (B,W)
    ol = objective.gather(1, loser_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, W, band)  # (B,W,band)
    gap = ol - ow[:, :, None]
    strict = gap > tie_eps
    keep = valid & strict

    # Flatten kept pairs.
    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)[:, None, None].expand(B, W, band)
    b_idx, w_pos, l_off = keep.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    w_idx = winner_idx[b_idx, w_pos]
    l_idx = loser_idx[b_idx, w_pos, l_off]

    # If no pairs, return empty.
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.zeros((0,), device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=empty.to(objective.dtype), meta={'reason': 'no_pairs'})

    # Weight by clipped objective gap (nonnegative).
    g = gap[b_idx, w_pos, l_off]
    w = ops.clamp(g, 0.0, gap_clip)
    w = ops.clamp(w, weight_min, gap_clip)

    # Optional global cap via top-k by weight (vectorized).
    if max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        _, sel = torch.topk(w, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel]
        w = w[sel]

    # Ensure correct dtypes/shapes.
    b_idx = b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)
    w_idx = w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)
    l_idx = l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)
    w = w.reshape(-1)

    meta = {
        'tie_eps': tie_eps,
        'band': band,
        'max_winners': max_winners,
        'max_pairs_total': max_pairs_total,
        'gap_clip': gap_clip
    }

    _ = log_prob  # present for contract; not used in pairing
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=w, meta=meta)

g_ir.intuition: All-pairs builder with tie-zone filtering and symmetric dedup, plus an explicit per-instance cap to prevent any single instance from dominating the batch; uses stable gap normalization and clamping while preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better).
    better = oi < oj

    # Constraint: tie-zone filter.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Constraint: de-duplicate symmetric pairs by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Gap for scoring/capping; normalize and clamp for stability.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
    mean = gap.mean()
    var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
    std = (var + eps).sqrt()
    gap_n = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
    gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Constraint: per-instance top-k cap to avoid one instance dominating pair volume.
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:

        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if flat.shape[1] > 0:
            k_eff = k_eff if k_eff < flat.shape[1] else flat.shape[1]
        vals, idx = flat.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)

        # Keep only valid (non -inf) selections.
        valid = vals.isfinite()
        b2 = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos = idx[valid]
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N

        b_idx = b2
        i_idx = i2
        j_idx = j2

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_instcap_norm', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance) if max_pairs_per_instance is not None else 0, 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

g_ir.intuition: Build a compact, high-signal set of pairwise preferences by anchoring each instance on its best (lowest objective) candidate, then selecting only the hardest losers with the largest objective gaps; this avoids quadratic all-pairs while keeping strong directional supervision (best beats clearly-worse).
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    # Per-instance cap (top-k losers for the best anchor)
    k_default = int(hp.get('pairs_per_instance', 2))
    k = int((extra.get('pairs_per_instance', k_default) if extra is not None else k_default))
    k = max(1, k)

    # Optional gap filtering to avoid near-ties
    thr_default = float(hp.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    thr = float((extra.get('gap_threshold', thr_default) if extra is not None else thr_default))

    B, N = objective.shape

    best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
    best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)

    # gap[b,i] > 0 means i is worse than best for that instance
    gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

    # Exclude the anchor itself and any losers not meeting the gap threshold
    valid = (gap > thr)
    valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

    # Ensure invalid entries never get selected by topk
    neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
    scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

    k_eff = min(k, N - 1)
    top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    loser_idx = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
    picked = top.values > neg_inf / 2  # robust validity check

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
    winner_idx = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

    b = b_idx[picked]
    w = winner_idx[picked]
    l = loser_idx[picked]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b, w, l), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_topk_gap', 'pairs_per_instance': k, 'gap_threshold': thr})

g_ir.name: builder_anchor_quantile_topk_normgap
g_ir.intuition: Combine a stable best-anchor star (always includes the clearest best-vs-worst comparisons) with dense all-pairs filtered by a tie-zone, then cap dense pairs via per-instance gap-quantile and a final global top-k on normalized gaps to keep supervision focused on decisive improvements while tightly controlling total pair count.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total budget across batch (0 => uncapped). Split between anchor and dense.
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))
    anchor_frac = float(hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.25))

    # Anchor star controls (best beats up to anchor_k worst/most-separated).
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 4))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    # Dense controls: per-instance quantile filter then global topk.
    dense_keep_q = float(hp.get('dense_keep_q', 0.85))

    # Normalization/clamping for stable scoring.
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Clamp helper values in Python scalars (deterministic, no randomness).
    if anchor_frac < 0.0:
        anchor_frac = 0.0
    if anchor_frac > 1.0:
        anchor_frac = 1.0
    if dense_keep_q < 0.0:
        dense_keep_q = 0.0
    if dense_keep_q > 1.0:
        dense_keep_q = 1.0

    # -------- Dense all-pairs candidates (directed wins i -> j).
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup: keep one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_d < j_d
    b_d = b_d[keep]
    i_d = i_d[keep]
    j_d = j_d[keep]

    gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # -------- Anchor star (best -> top-gap losers).
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap_to_best = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap_to_best > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap_to_best, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_a = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # -------- Budgeting.
    if max_pairs_total is not None and max_pairs_total > 0:
        anchor_budget = int(round(max_pairs_total * anchor_frac))
        if anchor_budget < 0:
            anchor_budget = 0
        if anchor_budget > max_pairs_total:
            anchor_budget = max_pairs_total
        dense_budget = max_pairs_total - anchor_budget

        # Cap anchors by raw gap (already high-signal).
        if anchor_budget <= 0:
            b_a = b_a[:0]
            i_a = i_a[:0]
            j_a = j_a[:0]
            gap_a = gap_a[:0]
        elif b_a.numel() > anchor_budget:
            vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_a, k=anchor_budget, largest=True, sorted=False)
            ok = vals.isfinite()
            sel = sel[ok]
            b_a = b_a[sel]
            i_a = i_a[sel]
            j_a = j_a[sel]
            gap_a = gap_a[sel]

        # Dense: per-instance quantile filter on gap, then global topk on normalized gap.
        if dense_budget <= 0:
            b_d = b_d[:0]
            i_d = i_d[:0]
            j_d = j_d[:0]
            gap_d = gap_d[:0]
        elif b_d.numel() > 0:
            # Per-instance thresholds: quantile over winners' positive gaps only.
            # Build per-instance gap list in [B, Pmax] with -inf padding.
            counts = torch.bincount(b_d, minlength=B)
            Pmax = int(counts.max().item()) if B > 0 else 0
            if Pmax > 0:
                neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
                gmat = objective.new_full((B, Pmax), neg_inf)
                # Compute positions within each batch via stable sort by b_d.
                order = torch.argsort(b_d)
                b_s = b_d[order]
                i_s = i_d[order]
                j_s = j_d[order]
                g_s = gap_d[order]

                new_grp = torch.ones(b_s.numel(), dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
                if b_s.numel() > 1:
                    new_grp[1:] = b_s[1:] != b_s[:-1]
                grp = new_grp.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1  # group id in sorted-by-b

                starts = torch.zeros(B, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
                if B > 1:
                    starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
                pos = torch.arange(b_s.numel(), device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts[b_s]

                gmat[b_s, pos] = g_s

                thr = torch.quantile(gmat, dense_keep_q, dim=1)  # (B,)
                thr = thr.where(counts > 0, thr.new_full((), float('inf')))

                keep_q = gap_d >= thr[b_d]
                b_d = b_d[keep_q]
                i_d = i_d[keep_q]
                j_d = j_d[keep_q]
                gap_d = gap_d[keep_q]

            # Normalize gaps for stable global topk.
            if b_d.numel() > dense_budget and dense_budget > 0:
                mean = gap_d.mean()
                var = (gap_d - mean).pow(2).mean()
                std = (var + eps).sqrt()
                gnorm = (gap_d - mean) / (std + eps)
                gnorm = gnorm.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

                vals, sel = torch.topk(gnorm, k=dense_budget, largest=True, sorted=False)
                ok = vals.isfinite()
                sel = sel[ok]
                b_d = b_d[sel]
                i_d = i_d[sel]
                j_d = j_d[sel]

    # Concatenate dense + anchor.
    if b_a.numel() > 0:
        b_out = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
        i_out = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
        j_out = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)
    else:
        b_out, i_out, j_out = b_d, i_d, j_d

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_out, i_out, j_out),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_quantile_topk_normgap',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total) if max_pairs_total is not None else 0,
            'anchor_k': int(anchor_k),
            'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap),
            'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac),
            'dense_keep_q': float(dense_keep_q),
            'gap_clip': float(gap_clip),
        },
    )

g_ir.intuition: Preserve dense strict-improvement + best-anchor star + per-anchor budget, but make constraint handling explicit by clamping and normalizing gap scores before topk so caps behave consistently across instances.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    per_anchor_cap = int(hp.get('per_anchor_cap', 0))    # 0 => derive from max_pairs_total

    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))  # 0 => no anchor supplement
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    # Explicit constraint handling for score stability.
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 1.0e6))
    norm_eps = float(hp.get('norm_eps', 1.0e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])
        gap = objective - best_obj

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_idx2 = b2[picked]
        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]

        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > 0:
        if per_anchor_cap <= 0:
            denom = int(B * N) if int(B * N) > 0 else 1
            per_anchor_cap = max(1, int((max_pairs_total + denom - 1) // denom))

        gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        gap_pairs = torch.clamp(gap_pairs, 0.0, float(gap_clip))

        # Normalize gaps by per-instance scale to make caps comparable across batch instances.
        inst_scale = (objective.max(dim=1).values - objective.min(dim=1).values).clamp(min=norm_eps)
        gap_pairs = gap_pairs / inst_scale[b_idx]

        anchor_id = b_idx * N + i_idx
        P = anchor_id.numel()

        order = torch.argsort(anchor_id)
        anchor_s = anchor_id[order]
        b_s = b_idx[order]
        i_s = i_idx[order]
        j_s = j_idx[order]
        gap_s = gap_pairs[order]

        new_group = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P > 1:
            new_group[1:] = anchor_s[1:] != anchor_s[:-1]
        group_id = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        G = int(group_id[-1].item()) + 1

        ones = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = counts.scatter_add(0, group_id, ones)
        starts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        if G > 1:
            starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos = torch.arange(P, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts[group_id]

        # Second-stage per-group topk by sorting within group on (-gap).
        gap_min = gap_s.min() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        gap_max = gap_s.max() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(1.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        span = (gap_max - gap_min).clamp(min=1.0)
        comp = group_id.to(gap_s.dtype) * (span + 1.0) + (gap_max - gap_s) / (span + 1.0)
        comp_order = torch.argsort(comp)

        anchor_c = anchor_s[comp_order]
        b_c = b_s[comp_order]
        i_c = i_s[comp_order]
        j_c = j_s[comp_order]
        gap_c = gap_s[comp_order]

        P2 = anchor_c.numel()
        new_group2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P2 > 1:
            new_group2[1:] = anchor_c[1:] != anchor_c[:-1]
        group2 = new_group2.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        G2 = int(group2[-1].item()) + 1

        ones2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = torch.zeros(G2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = counts2.scatter_add(0, group2, ones2)
        starts2 = torch.zeros(G2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        if G2 > 1:
            starts2[1:] = counts2.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos2 = torch.arange(P2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts2[group2]

        keep2 = pos2 < per_anchor_cap

        b_kept = b_c[keep2]
        i_kept = i_c[keep2]
        j_kept = j_c[keep2]
        gap_kept = gap_c[keep2]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))  # 0 => uncapped
    max_out_per_item = int(hp.get('max_out_per_item', 0))  # 0 => uncapped per (b,i) row
    gap_clip = float(hp.get('gap_clip', 10.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]

    # Candidate strict preference edges (lower objective is better).
    better = oi < oj

    # Constraint: tie-zone filter.
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Constraint: de-duplicate symmetric pairs by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Gap for scoring; normalize and clamp for stability.
    gap = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
    if gap.numel() > 0:
        mean = gap.mean()
        var = (gap - mean).pow(2).mean()
        std = (var + eps).sqrt()
        gap_n = (gap - mean) / (std + eps)
    else:
        gap_n = gap
    gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Explicit constraint: cap outgoing edges per winner row (b,i) to prevent a single item
    # from dominating within an instance.
    if max_out_per_item is not None and max_out_per_item > 0 and N > 0:
        score_row = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score_row[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

        k_row = max_out_per_item if max_out_per_item < N else N
        vals_r, idx_r = score_row.topk(k_row, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B,N,k)
        valid_r = vals_r.isfinite()

        bi = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        ii = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[1]
        kk = valid_r.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[2]
        jj = idx_r[bi, ii, kk]

        b_idx = bi
        i_idx = ii
        j_idx = jj

        gap_sel = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]
        if gap_sel.numel() > 0:
            mean2 = gap_sel.mean()
            var2 = (gap_sel - mean2).pow(2).mean()
            std2 = (var2 + eps).sqrt()
            gap_n = (gap_sel - mean2) / (std2 + eps)
        else:
            gap_n = gap_sel
        gap_n = gap_n.clamp(-gap_clip, gap_clip)

    # Constraint: per-instance top-k cap to avoid one instance dominating pair volume.
    if max_pairs_per_instance is not None and max_pairs_per_instance > 0:
        score = objective.new_full((B, N, N), float('-inf'))
        score[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx] = gap_n

        flat = score.reshape(B, N * N)
        k_eff = max_pairs_per_instance
        if flat.shape[1] > 0:
            k_eff = k_eff if k_eff < flat.shape[1] else flat.shape[1]
        vals, idx = flat.topk(k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)

        valid = vals.isfinite()
        b2 = valid.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
        pos = idx[valid]
        i2 = pos // N
        j2 = pos - i2 * N

        b_idx = b2
        i_idx = i2
        j_idx = j2

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_tie_dedup_rowcap_norm', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_out_per_item': int(max_out_per_item) if max_out_per_item is not None else 0, 'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance) if max_pairs_per_instance is not None else 0, 'gap_clip': float(gap_clip)})

g_ir.intuition: Keep dense strict-improvement pairs (tie-zone filtered + symmetric dedup) plus optional best-anchor star, but replace per-anchor budgeting with a per-instance (per batch item) budget that allocates pairs by gap strength so each instance contributes a controlled share of the total pair budget.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total budget across all instances (0 => uncapped).
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))

    # Per-instance cap (0 => derive from max_pairs_total / B).
    per_instance_cap = int(hp.get('per_instance_cap', 0))

    # Optional: reserve a share of each instance budget for anchor-star pairs.
    anchor_frac = float(hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.25))

    # Anchor controls (best -> top-gap losers).
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_d, i_d, j_d = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup by keeping one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_d < j_d
    b_d = b_d[keep]
    i_d = i_d[keep]
    j_d = j_d[keep]

    gap_d = objective[b_d, j_d] - objective[b_d, i_d]

    # Anchor star pairs.
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_a = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # If uncapped, just return combined pairs.
    if not (max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0):
        if b_a.numel() > 0:
            b_idx = torch.cat([b_d, b_a], dim=0)
            i_idx = torch.cat([i_d, i_a], dim=0)
            j_idx = torch.cat([j_d, j_a], dim=0)
        else:
            b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = b_d, i_d, j_d
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_perinstance_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'per_instance_cap': int(per_instance_cap), 'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

    # Derive per-instance cap if needed.
    if per_instance_cap <= 0:
        denom = int(B) if int(B) > 0 else 1
        per_instance_cap = max(1, int((max_pairs_total + denom - 1) // denom))

    # Split per-instance cap into anchor vs dense.
    af = anchor_frac
    if af < 0.0:
        af = 0.0
    if af > 1.0:
        af = 1.0
    cap_a = int(per_instance_cap * af)
    cap_d = int(per_instance_cap - cap_a)

    # Select top-k per instance for anchor pairs.
    keep_a = b_a.new_zeros((b_a.numel(),), dtype=torch.bool)
    if b_a.numel() > 0 and cap_a > 0:
        # Sort by instance id, then by decreasing gap.
        order = torch.argsort(b_a)
        b_s = b_a[order]
        i_s = i_a[order]
        j_s = j_a[order]
        g_s = gap_a[order]

        P = b_s.numel()
        new_group = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P > 1:
            new_group[1:] = b_s[1:] != b_s[:-1]
        group = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        G = int(group[-1].item()) + 1

        ones = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts = counts.scatter_add(0, group, ones)
        starts = torch.zeros(G, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        if G > 1:
            starts[1:] = counts.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]

        # Stable within-instance ranking by decreasing gap using composite key.
        gmin = g_s.min() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        gmax = g_s.max() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(1.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        span = (gmax - gmin).clamp(min=1.0)
        comp = group.to(g_s.dtype) * (span + 1.0) + (gmax - g_s) / (span + 1.0)
        o2 = torch.argsort(comp)

        b_c = b_s[o2]
        i_c = i_s[o2]
        j_c = j_s[o2]

        P2 = b_c.numel()
        new2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P2 > 1:
            new2[1:] = b_c[1:] != b_c[:-1]
        group2 = new2.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        ones2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = torch.zeros(int(group2[-1].item()) + 1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = counts2.scatter_add(0, group2, ones2)
        starts2 = torch.zeros_like(counts2)
        if starts2.numel() > 1:
            starts2[1:] = counts2.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos2 = torch.arange(P2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts2[group2]

        ka = pos2 < cap_a
        # Map back to original indices (through order then o2).
        inv = order[o2]
        keep_a.scatter_(0, inv, ka)

    # Select top-k per instance for dense pairs.
    keep_d = b_d.new_zeros((b_d.numel(),), dtype=torch.bool)
    if b_d.numel() > 0 and cap_d > 0:
        order = torch.argsort(b_d)
        b_s = b_d[order]
        i_s = i_d[order]
        j_s = j_d[order]
        g_s = gap_d[order]

        P = b_s.numel()
        new_group = torch.ones(P, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P > 1:
            new_group[1:] = b_s[1:] != b_s[:-1]
        group = new_group.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1

        gmin = g_s.min() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        gmax = g_s.max() if P > 0 else torch.tensor(1.0, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        span = (gmax - gmin).clamp(min=1.0)
        comp = group.to(g_s.dtype) * (span + 1.0) + (gmax - g_s) / (span + 1.0)
        o2 = torch.argsort(comp)

        b_c = b_s[o2]

        P2 = b_c.numel()
        new2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
        if P2 > 1:
            new2[1:] = b_c[1:] != b_c[:-1]
        group2 = new2.long().cumsum(dim=0) - 1
        ones2 = torch.ones(P2, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = torch.zeros(int(group2[-1].item()) + 1, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        counts2 = counts2.scatter_add(0, group2, ones2)
        starts2 = torch.zeros_like(counts2)
        if starts2.numel() > 1:
            starts2[1:] = counts2.cumsum(dim=0)[:-1]
        pos2 = torch.arange(P2, device=device, dtype=torch.long) - starts2[group2]

        kd = pos2 < cap_d
        inv = order[o2]
        keep_d.scatter_(0, inv, kd)

    # Materialize selected pairs.
    b_out = torch.cat([b_d[keep_d], b_a[keep_a]], dim=0) if b_a.numel() > 0 else b_d[keep_d]
    i_out = torch.cat([i_d[keep_d], i_a[keep_a]], dim=0) if b_a.numel() > 0 else i_d[keep_d]
    j_out = torch.cat([j_d[keep_d], j_a[keep_a]], dim=0) if b_a.numel() > 0 else j_d[keep_d]

    # Final global cap safety.
    if b_out.numel() > max_pairs_total:
        gap_out = objective[b_out, j_out] - objective[b_out, i_out]
        vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_out, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
        ok = vals.isfinite()
        sel = sel[ok]
        b_out = b_out[sel]
        i_out = i_out[sel]
        j_out = j_out[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_out, i_out, j_out), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_perinstance_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'per_instance_cap': int(per_instance_cap), 'anchor_frac': float(anchor_frac), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    # Constraint knobs
    tie_eps = hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0)
    max_pairs_per_instance = hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 2048)
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(max_pairs_per_instance)
    if max_pairs_per_instance < 1:
        max_pairs_per_instance = 1

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    best = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (B,1)
    all_idx = torch.arange(N, device=device)[None, :].expand(B, N)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, N)
    winner_idx = best.expand(B, N)
    loser_idx = all_idx

    # Base: no self-pairs
    base_mask = winner_idx != loser_idx

    # Explicit constraint: filter near-ties between best and candidate (tie-zone)
    best_obj = objective.gather(1, best).expand(B, N)
    gap = objective - best_obj
    tie_mask = gap > tie_eps

    mask = base_mask & tie_mask

    # Per-instance cap: keep top-k largest gaps (hardest losers) among valid pairs
    gap_pos = torch.clamp(gap, min=0.0)
    scores = gap_pos.masked_fill(~mask, float('-inf'))
    k = max_pairs_per_instance
    if k > N - 1:
        k = N - 1
    if k < 1:
        k = 1
    _, topk_idx = scores.topk(k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    cap_mask = torch.zeros((B, N), dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
    cap_mask.scatter_(1, topk_idx, True)

    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', hp.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))) if extra is not None else float(hp.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))) if extra is not None else int(hp.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 0))

    B, K = objective.shape

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, K)

    obj_best = objective.gather(1, best).expand(B, K)
    gap = objective - obj_best
    mask = (winner_idx != all_idx) & (gap > thr)

    if max_pairs and max_pairs > 0 and max_pairs < K:
        gap_masked = gap.masked_fill(~mask, float('-inf'))
        _, topk_idx = gap_masked.topk(k=max_pairs, dim=1, largest=True)
        row_sel = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, max_pairs)
        chosen_ok = gap_masked.gather(1, topk_idx).isfinite()

        b = row_sel[chosen_ok]
        w = best.expand(B, max_pairs)[chosen_ok]
        l = topk_idx[chosen_ok]
    else:
        b = b_idx[mask]
        w = winner_idx[mask]
        l = all_idx[mask]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b, w, l), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_best_capped_gap'})

g_ir.intuition: Use a per-instance anchor-star around the current best objective (stable coverage) and add a small set of hardest high-gap pairs (strong signal) while enforcing a strict global pair budget via vectorized top-k selection.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = (extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {})

    # Pair budget and mixture: reserve some budget for anchor-star, spend the rest on top gap pairs.
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', hp.get('max_pairs', 128)) if extra is not None else hp.get('max_pairs', 128))
    anchor_frac = float(extra.get('anchor_frac', hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.5)) if extra is not None else hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.5))
    gap_threshold = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', hp.get('gap_threshold', 0.0)) if extra is not None else hp.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))

    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Winners are lower objective (lower is better).
    best = objective.argmin(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # [B,1]

    all_k = torch.arange(K, device=device)[None, :].expand(B, K)
    all_b = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, K)

    # Anchor-star pairs: best vs everyone else.
    aw = best.expand(B, K)
    al = all_k
    amask = aw != al
    ab = all_b[amask]
    aw = aw[amask]
    al = al[amask]

    # Cap anchor contribution.
    anchor_cap = int(max_pairs * anchor_frac)
    if anchor_cap < 0:
        anchor_cap = 0
    if ab.numel() > anchor_cap:
        # Keep largest anchor gaps (most informative among anchor edges).
        anchor_gap = (objective[ab, al] - objective[ab, aw])
        keep = torch.topk(anchor_gap, k=anchor_cap, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        ab = ab[keep]
        aw = aw[keep]
        al = al[keep]

    # Extra top-gap pairs within each instance (global top-k over all valid pairs).
    diff = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]  # [B,K,K] = obj[j] - obj[i]
    mask = diff > gap_threshold
    gb, gw, gl = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Remove any self-pairs defensively.
    neq = gw != gl
    gb = gb[neq]
    gw = gw[neq]
    gl = gl[neq]

    remaining = max_pairs - int(ab.numel())
    if remaining < 0:
        remaining = 0

    if gb.numel() > remaining:
        scores = diff[gb, gw, gl]
        keep = torch.topk(scores, k=remaining, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        gb = gb[keep]
        gw = gw[keep]
        gl = gl[keep]

    # Concatenate (may include duplicates; duplicates are harmless for most losses and keep builder simple/robust).
    b_idx = torch.cat([ab, gb], dim=0)
    winner_idx = torch.cat([aw, gw], dim=0)
    loser_idx = torch.cat([al, gl], dim=0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_topk_gapmix', 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'anchor_frac': anchor_frac, 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold})

g_ir.name: builder_rankband_neighbor_disagreement_weighted
g_ir.intuition: Paradigm shift from dense all-pairs to sparse rank-band neighborhood pairs, focusing on local decision boundaries and adding a disagreement-driven lane from model log-prob ranking vs objective ranking; weights emphasize moderate (near-boundary) gaps rather than only extreme gaps.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))
    band = int(hp.get('band', 4))          # neighborhood radius in rank space (>=1)
    use_disagree = bool(hp.get('use_disagree', True))
    w_clip = float(hp.get('w_clip', 50.0))
    eps = float(hp.get('eps', 1e-12))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    if band < 1:
        band = 1

    # Rank orders (lower objective is better; higher log_prob is better)
    ord_obj = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, stable=True)  # (B,N)
    ord_lp = torch.argsort(-log_prob, dim=1, stable=True)   # (B,N)

    # Inverse ranks
    pos = torch.arange(N, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[None, :].expand(B, N)
    inv_obj = torch.empty((B, N), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    inv_obj.scatter_(1, ord_obj, pos)
    inv_lp = torch.empty((B, N), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    inv_lp.scatter_(1, ord_lp, pos)

    # Rank-band neighborhood mask: only compare items whose objective ranks are within +/- band.
    r = inv_obj.to(objective.dtype)
    dr = (r[:, :, None] - r[:, None, :]).abs()
    band_mask = (dr > 0) & (dr <= float(band))

    # Only keep strict improvements by objective (winner has lower objective).
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    m_obj = band_mask & better

    # Optional disagreement lane: within band, keep pairs where model ranking disagrees with objective ranking.
    # If model thinks j should be ahead of i (inv_lp[j] < inv_lp[i]) but objective says i beats j, include.
    if use_disagree:
        disagree = inv_lp[:, None, :] < inv_lp[:, :, None]
        m = m_obj | (band_mask & better & disagree)
    else:
        m = m_obj

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = m.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # De-duplicate symmetric by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Weight: triangular emphasis on near-boundary objective gaps within selected pairs.
    # w = 1 / (1 + gap) scaled by a rank-distance factor that downweights farther neighbors.
    if b_idx.numel() > 0:
        gap = (objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]).clamp_min(0.0)
        rdi = inv_obj[b_idx, i_idx]
        rdj = inv_obj[b_idx, j_idx]
        rd = (rdi - rdj).abs().to(objective.dtype)
        rank_factor = (float(band) + 1.0 - rd).clamp_min(1.0) / (float(band) + 1.0)
        w = rank_factor / (1.0 + gap)
        w = w.clamp(0.0, w_clip)
    else:
        w = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx),
        weight=w,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rankband_neighbor_disagreement_weighted',
            'tie_eps': float(tie_eps),
            'band': int(band),
            'use_disagree': bool(use_disagree),
            'w_clip': float(w_clip),
            'eps': float(eps),
        },
    )

g_ir.name: builder_allpairs_tie_anchor_percentile_budget
g_ir.intuition: Keep dense strict-improvement pairs (tie-zone filtered + symmetric dedup) plus optional best-anchor star, but replace per-anchor top-k with a global percentile gap threshold so the batch keeps only sufficiently strong improvements while adapting to each batch's gap distribution.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Global budget with adaptive percentile cap over pair gaps.
    # max_pairs_total<=0 => uncapped.
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))
    # Keep pairs whose gap is in the top (1-q) fraction; q in [0,1].
    gap_quantile = float(hp.get('gap_quantile', 0.9))

    # Optional: anchor-on-best star (best -> top-gap losers).
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Dense all-pairs: i beats j if objective[i] < objective[j] and not in tie-zone.
    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # De-duplicate symmetric duplicates by enforcing i < j.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Optional: anchor-on-best star (best -> top-gap losers).
    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_idx2 = b2[picked]
        i_idx2 = w2[picked]
        j_idx2 = loser[picked]

        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_idx2], dim=0)
        i_idx = torch.cat([i_idx, i_idx2], dim=0)
        j_idx = torch.cat([j_idx, j_idx2], dim=0)

    # Percentile gap cap + optional final global topk.
    if b_idx.numel() > 0:
        gap_pairs = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]

        q = gap_quantile
        if q < 0.0:
            q = 0.0
        if q > 1.0:
            q = 1.0

        # If q==0, threshold is min => keep all; if q==1, threshold is max => keep only max-gap ties.
        thr = torch.quantile(gap_pairs, q)
        keep_gap = gap_pairs >= thr

        b_idx = b_idx[keep_gap]
        i_idx = i_idx[keep_gap]
        j_idx = j_idx[keep_gap]
        gap_kept = gap_pairs[keep_gap]

        if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0 and b_idx.numel() > max_pairs_total:
            vals, sel = torch.topk(gap_kept, k=max_pairs_total, largest=True, sorted=False)
            ok = vals.isfinite()
            sel = sel[ok]
            b_idx = b_idx[sel]
            i_idx = i_idx[sel]
            j_idx = j_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, i_idx, j_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'allpairs_tie_dedup_anchor_percentile_budget', 'tie_eps': float(tie_eps), 'max_pairs_total': int(max_pairs_total), 'gap_quantile': float(gap_quantile), 'anchor_k': int(anchor_k), 'anchor_gap': float(anchor_gap)})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    hp = extra.get('hyperparams', {}) if extra is not None else {}

    tie_eps = float(hp.get('tie_eps', 0.0))

    # Total pair budget (0 => uncapped). Budget is split between anchor star and dense pairs.
    max_pairs_total = int(hp.get('max_pairs_total', 0))
    anchor_frac = float(hp.get('anchor_frac', 0.25))

    # Anchor controls
    anchor_k = int(hp.get('anchor_k', 0))
    anchor_gap = float(hp.get('anchor_gap', tie_eps))

    # Percentile pre-cap for dense pairs (only used when max_pairs_total > 0)
    # Keep pairs with gap >= quantile(gap, q). q in [0,1].
    dense_keep_q = float(hp.get('dense_keep_q', 0.85))

    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    oi = objective[:, :, None]
    oj = objective[:, None, :]
    better = oi < oj
    if tie_eps > 0.0:
        better = better & ((oj - oi) > tie_eps)

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = better.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Symmetric de-dup by keeping one representative per unordered pair.
    keep = i_idx < j_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    i_idx = i_idx[keep]
    j_idx = j_idx[keep]

    # Compute dense pair gaps once; used for capping.
    gap_dense = objective[b_idx, j_idx] - objective[b_idx, i_idx]

    # Build anchor star pairs (best beats selected losers).
    b_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    i_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    j_a = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
    gap_anchor = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    if anchor_k > 0 and N > 1:
        best = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # (B,)
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best[:, None])  # (B,1)
        gap = objective - best_obj  # (B,N)

        valid = gap > anchor_gap
        valid.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)

        neg_inf = torch.finfo(objective.dtype).min
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

        k_eff = anchor_k
        if k_eff < 1:
            k_eff = 1
        if k_eff > (N - 1):
            k_eff = N - 1

        top = torch.topk(scores, k=k_eff, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
        loser = top.indices  # (B,k_eff)
        picked = top.values > (neg_inf / 2)

        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)
        w2 = best[:, None].expand(B, k_eff)

        b_a = b2[picked]
        i_a = w2[picked]
        j_a = loser[picked]
        gap_anchor = objective[b_a, j_a] - objective[b_a, i_a]

    # Apply per-batch budget allocation.
    if max_pairs_total and max_pairs_total > 0:
